   102→// GetAgentChatSessions returns all available agent chat sessions from the Factory Droid CLI,
   103→// optionally filtered to sessions associated with the given projectPath. When debugRaw is true,
   104→// additional raw session details may be included in the converted sessions.
   105→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   106→	files, err := listSessionFiles()
   107→	if err != nil {
   108→		return nil, err
   109→	}
   110→	result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, len(files))
   111→	normalizedProject := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
   112→
   113→	for _, file := range files {
   114→		if normalizedProject != "" && !sessionMentionsProject(file.Path, normalizedProject) {
   115→			continue
   116→		}
   117→		session, err := parseFactorySession(file.Path)
   118→		if err != nil {
   119→			slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping session", "path", file.Path, "error", err)
   120→			continue
   121→		}
   122→		chat := convertToAgentSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
   123→		if chat != nil {
   124→			result = append(result, *chat)
   125→		}
   126→	}
   127→	return result, nil
   128→}

   148→// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Factory Droid CLI agent for the given project and,
   149→// when a session callback is provided, watches for new or updated chat sessions and
   150→// invokes the callback as they are discovered.
   151→func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   152→	if sessionCallback == nil {
   153→		return ExecuteDroid(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
   157→	defer cancel()
   158→
   159→	watchErr := make(chan error, 1)
   160→	go func() {
   161→		watchErr <- watchSessions(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
   162→	}()
   163→
   164→	err := ExecuteDroid(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   165→	cancel()
   166→
   167→	if werr := <-watchErr; werr != nil && !errors.Is(werr, context.Canceled) {
   168→		slog.Warn("droidcli: watcher stopped with error", "error", werr)
   169→	}
   170→
   171→	if err != nil {
   172→		return fmt.Errorf("factory droid CLI execution failed: %w", err)
   173→	}
   174→	return nil
   175→}

   186→func convertToAgentSession(session *fdSession, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
   187→	if session == nil {

   209→		}

   214→func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
   215→	var execErr *exec.Error
   216→	var pathErr *os.PathError
   217→	switch {
   218→	case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
   219→		return "not_found"
   220→	case errors.As(err, &pathErr) && errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission):
   221→		return "permission_denied"
   222→	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
   223→		return "permission_denied"
   224→	default:
   225→		return "version_failed"
   226→	}
   227→}
   228→
   229→func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
   230→	var builder strings.Builder
   231→	switch errorType {
   232→	case "not_found":
   233→		builder.WriteString("Factory Droid CLI was not found.\n\n")
   234→		if isCustom {
   235→			builder.WriteString("• Verify the custom path you provided is executable.\n")
   236→			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("• Provided command: %s\n", command))
   237→		} else {
   238→			builder.WriteString("• Install the Factory CLI and ensure `droid` is on your PATH.\n")
   239→			builder.WriteString("• Re-run `specstory check droid` after installation.\n")
   240→		}
   241→	case "permission_denied":
   242→		builder.WriteString("SpecStory cannot execute the Factory CLI due to permissions.\n\n")
   243→		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Try: chmod +x %s\n", command))
   244→	default:
   245→		builder.WriteString("`droid --version` failed.\n\n")
   246→		if stderr != "" {
   247→			builder.WriteString("Error output:\n")
   248→			builder.WriteString(stderr)
   249→			builder.WriteString("\n\n")
   250→		}
   251→		builder.WriteString("Run `droid --version` manually to diagnose, then retry.")
   252→	}
   253→	return builder.String()
   254→}

   256→var ansiRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]`)

   258→func sanitizeDroidVersion(raw string) string {
   259→	clean := strings.ReplaceAll(raw, "\r", "")
   260→	clean = ansiRegexp.ReplaceAllString(clean, "")
   261→	return clean
   262→}

   264→func extractDroidVersion(raw string) string {
   265→	lines := strings.Split(raw, "\n")
   266→	var filtered []string
   267→	for _, line := range lines {
   268→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   269→		if line == "" {
   270→			continue
   271→		}
   272→		filtered = append(filtered, line)
   273→	}
   274→	if len(filtered) == 0 {
   275→		return ""
   276→	}
   277→	return filtered[len(filtered)-1]
   278→}

   310→func classifyDroidPath(command string, resolvedPath string) string {
   311→	if resolvedPath == "" {
   312→		if filepath.IsAbs(command) {
   313→			return "absolute_path"
   314→		}
   315→		return "unknown"
   316→	}
   317→	resolvedLower := strings.ToLower(resolvedPath)
   318→	if strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "homebrew") || strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "/opt/homebrew/") {
   319→		return "homebrew"
   320→	}
   321→	if strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "/.local/bin/") {
   322→		return "user_local"
   323→	}
   324→	if strings.Contains(resolvedLower, "/.factory/") {
   325→		return "factory_local"
   326→	}
   327→	if filepath.IsAbs(command) {
   328→		return "absolute_path"
   329→	}
   330→	return "system_path"
   331→}

   338→func sessionMentionsProject(filePath string, projectPath string) bool {
   339→	projectPath = strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
   340→	if projectPath == "" {
   341→		return false
   342→	}
   343→
   344→	canonicalProject := canonicalizePath(projectPath)
   345→	if sessionRoot := extractSessionWorkspaceRoot(filePath); sessionRoot != "" {
   346→		canonicalRoot := canonicalizePath(sessionRoot)
   347→		if canonicalProject != "" && canonicalRoot != "" {
   348→			return canonicalRoot == canonicalProject
   349→		}
   350→		return strings.TrimSpace(sessionRoot) == projectPath
   351→	}
   352→
   353→	return sessionMentionsProjectText(filePath, projectPath)
   354→}
   355→
   356→func extractSessionWorkspaceRoot(filePath string) string {
   357→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   358→	if err != nil {
   359→		return ""
   360→	}
   361→	defer func() {
   362→		_ = file.Close()
   363→	}()
   364→
   365→	var workspaceRoot string
   366→	scanErr := scanLines(file, func(line string) error {
   367→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   368→		if trimmed == "" {
   369→			return nil
   370→		}
   371→		var env jsonlEnvelope
   372→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &env); err != nil {
   373→			return nil
   374→		}
   375→		if env.Type != "session_start" {
   376→			return nil
   377→		}
   378→		var event sessionStartEvent
   379→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   380→			return nil
   381→		}
   382→		workspaceRoot = firstNonEmpty(event.CWD, event.WorkspaceRoot, event.Session.CWD, event.Session.WorkspaceRoot)
   383→		return errStopScan
   384→	})
   385→	if scanErr != nil && !errors.Is(scanErr, errStopScan) {
   386→		return ""
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	return strings.TrimSpace(workspaceRoot)
   390→}
   391→
   392→func canonicalizePath(path string) string {
   393→	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
   394→	if trimmed == "" {
   395→		return ""
   396→	}
   397→	canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(trimmed)
   398→	if err == nil {
   399→		return canonical
   400→	}
   401→	if abs, absErr := filepath.Abs(trimmed); absErr == nil {
   402→		return filepath.Clean(abs)
   403→	}
   404→	return filepath.Clean(trimmed)
   405→}
   406→
   407→func sessionMentionsProjectText(filePath string, projectPath string) bool {
   408→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   409→	if err != nil {
   410→		return false
   411→	}
   412→	defer func() {
   413→		_ = file.Close()
   414→	}()
   415→	needle := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
   416→	short := filepath.Base(projectPath)
   417→	foundLines := 0
   418→	err = scanLines(file, func(line string) error {
   419→		if needle != "" && strings.Contains(line, needle) {
   420→			return errStopScan
   421→		}
   422→		if short != "" && strings.Contains(line, short) {
   423→			foundLines++
   424→			if foundLines > 2 {
   425→				return errStopScan
   426→			}
   427→		}
   428→		return nil
   429→	})
   430→
   431→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStopScan) {
   432→		slog.Warn("error scanning session file", "path", filePath, "err", err)
   433→		return false
   434→	}
   435→
   436→	return errors.Is(err, errStopScan)
   437→}
   438→
   439→// writeFactoryDebugRaw writes pretty-printed JSON files for each line in the session's JSONL.
   440→// Each JSONL line becomes a numbered file (1.json, 2.json, etc.) matching the Claude Code provider format.
   441→func writeFactoryDebugRaw(session *fdSession) error {
   442→	if session == nil {
   443→		return nil
   444→	}
   445→
   446→	dir := spi.GetDebugDir(session.ID)
   447→	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   448→		return fmt.Errorf("droidcli: unable to create debug dir: %w", err)
   449→	}
   450→
   451→	// Clean existing files from the debug directory
   452→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
   453→	if err == nil {
   454→		for _, entry := range entries {
   455→			if !entry.IsDir() {
   456→				_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name()))
   457→			}
   458→		}
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Split JSONL into individual lines and write each as a pretty-printed JSON file
   462→	lines := strings.Split(session.RawData, "\n")
   463→	lineNumber := 0
   464→	for _, line := range lines {
   465→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   466→		if trimmed == "" {
   467→			continue
   468→		}
   469→
   470→		// Parse the JSON line
   471→		var data map[string]interface{}
   472→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &data); err != nil {
   473→			slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed JSONL line in debug-raw",
   474→				"lineNumber", lineNumber+1,
   475→				"error", err)
   476→			continue
   477→		}
   478→
   479→		lineNumber++
   480→
   481→		// Pretty-print and write to numbered file
   482→		prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(data, "", "  ")
   483→		if err != nil {
   484→			slog.Debug("droidcli: failed to marshal JSON for debug-raw",
   485→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   486→				"error", err)
   487→			continue
   488→		}
   489→
   490→		filePath := filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", lineNumber))
   491→		if err := os.WriteFile(filePath, prettyJSON, 0o644); err != nil {
   492→			slog.Debug("droidcli: failed to write debug-raw file",
   493→				"path", filePath,
   494→				"error", err)
   495→		}
   496→	}
   497→
   498→	slog.Debug("droidcli: wrote debug-raw files",
   499→		"sessionId", session.ID,
   500→		"fileCount", lineNumber)
   501→
   502→	return nil
   503→}
   504→

   198→func classifyGeminiCheckError(err error) string {
   199→	var execErr *exec.Error
   200→	var pathErr *os.PathError
   201→
   202→	switch {
   203→	case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
   204→		return "not_found"
   205→	case errors.As(err, &pathErr):
   206→		if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission) {
   207→			return "permission_denied"
   208→		}
   209→	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
   210→		return "permission_denied"
   211→	}
   212→	return "version_failed"
   213→}

   215→func buildGeminiCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, geminiCmd string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
   216→	var b strings.Builder
   217→
   218→	switch errorType {
   219→	case "not_found":
   220→		b.WriteString("Gemini CLI could not be found.\n\n")
   221→		if isCustom {
   222→			b.WriteString("• Verify the path you supplied actually points to the `gemini` executable.\n")
   223→			b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("• Provided command: %s\n", geminiCmd))

   226→			b.WriteString("• Ensure `gemini` is on your PATH or pass a custom command via `specstory check gemini -c \"path/to/gemini\"`.\n")
   227→		}

   229→		b.WriteString("Gemini CLI exists but isn't executable.\n\n")
   230→		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("• Fix permissions: `chmod +x %s`\n", geminiCmd))
   231→		b.WriteString("• Some package managers install the binary as root; run SpecStory with a path you can execute.\n")
   232→	default:

   234→		if stderr != "" {

   236→		}
   237→		b.WriteString("• Try running `gemini --version` directly in your terminal.\n")
   238→		b.WriteString("• If you upgraded recently, reinstall the CLI to refresh dependencies.\n")
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	return b.String()

   268→// convertToAgentChatSession converts a GeminiSession to the provider-agnostic AgentChatSession format.
   269→// Used by both sync mode (GetAgentChatSession/GetAgentChatSessions) and watch mode.
   270→func convertToAgentChatSession(session *GeminiSession, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
   271→	// Generate structured session data
   272→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(session, workspaceRoot)
   273→	if err != nil {
   274→		slog.Error("convertToAgentChatSession: failed to generate session data",
   275→			"sessionId", session.ID,
   276→			"error", err)
   277→		return nil
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	// Extract slug from first user message
   281→	var slug string
   282→	for _, msg := range session.Messages {
   283→		if msg.Type == "user" {
   284→			slug = spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(msgContent(msg))
   285→			break
   286→		}
   287→	}
   288→	if slug == "" {
   289→		slug = "gemini-session"
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	// Raw data
   293→	rawDataBytes, _ := json.Marshal(session)
   294→
   295→	// Write provider-specific debug files if requested
   296→	if debugRaw {
   297→		if err := writeDebugRawFiles(session); err != nil {
   298→			slog.Debug("convertToAgentChatSession: failed to write debug files",
   299→				"sessionId", session.ID,
   300→				"error", err)
   301→		}
   302→	}
   303→
   304→	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
   305→		SessionID:   session.ID,
   306→		CreatedAt:   session.StartTime,
   307→		Slug:        slug,
   308→		SessionData: sessionData,
   309→		RawData:     string(rawDataBytes),
   310→	}
   311→}
   312→
   313→// writeDebugRawFiles writes debug JSON files for a Gemini CLI session.
   314→// Each message is written as a numbered JSON file in .specstory/debug/<session-id>/
   315→func writeDebugRawFiles(session *GeminiSession) error {
   316→	debugDir := spi.GetDebugDir(session.ID)
   317→	if err := os.MkdirAll(debugDir, 0o755); err != nil {
   318→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create debug dir: %w", err)
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	for idx, msg := range session.Messages {
   322→		number := idx + 1
   323→		entry := map[string]interface{}{
   324→			"index":      number,
   325→			"type":       msg.Type,
   326→			"timestamp":  msg.Timestamp,
   327→			"model":      msg.Model,
   328→			"content":    msgContent(msg),
   329→			"rawContent": msg.Content,
   330→			"toolCalls":  msg.ToolCalls,
   331→			"thoughts":   msg.Thoughts,
   332→			"tokens":     msg.Tokens,
   333→			"logs":       session.LogsForMessage(msgContent(msg)),
   334→		}
   335→
   336→		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(entry, "", "  ")
   337→		if err != nil {
   338→			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: failed to marshal", "index", number, "error", err)
   339→			continue
   340→		}
   341→
   342→		filename := filepath.Join(debugDir, fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", number))
   343→		if err := os.WriteFile(filename, data, 0o644); err != nil {
   344→			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: failed to write", "index", number, "error", err)
   345→			continue
   346→		}
   347→		slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: wrote file", "path", filename, "index", number)
   348→	}
   349→	return nil
   350→}

    54→func formatDuration(d time.Duration) string {
    55→	if d < time.Microsecond {
    56→		return fmt.Sprintf("%.0f nanoseconds", float64(d.Nanoseconds()))
    57→	} else if d < time.Millisecond {
    58→		return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f microseconds", float64(d.Nanoseconds())/1000)
    59→	} else if d < time.Second {
    60→		return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f milliseconds", float64(d.Nanoseconds())/1000000)
    61→	} else if d < time.Minute {
    62→		return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f seconds", d.Seconds())
    63→	} else {
    64→		return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f minutes", d.Minutes())
    65→	}
    66→}
    67→
    68→// ParseProjectSessions implements the algorithm for parsing JSONL files:
    69→// 1. Scan all JSONL files and process summaries and sidechains
    70→// 2. Eliminate duplicates by uuid (keep earliest by timestamp)
    71→// 3. Build parent/child DAGs from the JSON objects
    72→// 4. Merge DAGs with the same session ID (handles resumed sessions)
    73→// 5. Flatten each DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
    74→// 6. For each array, the session is the sessionId of the head
    75→func (p *JSONLParser) ParseProjectSessions(projectPath string, silent bool) error {
    76→	return p.parseProjectSessions(projectPath, silent, "")
    77→}
    78→
    79→// ParseProjectSessionsForSession parses JSONL files that match a specific session ID.
    80→// Files that don't contain the given sessionID are skipped for performance.
    81→// If sessionID is empty, this behaves identically to ParseProjectSessions.
    82→func (p *JSONLParser) ParseProjectSessionsForSession(projectPath string, silent bool, sessionID string) error {
    83→	return p.parseProjectSessions(projectPath, silent, sessionID)
    84→}
    85→
    86→func (p *JSONLParser) parseProjectSessions(projectPath string, silent bool, sessionID string) error {
    87→	// Track overall parsing time
    88→	parseStartTime := time.Now()
    89→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: Starting JSONL parsing")
    90→
    91→	// Step 1: Scan all JSONL files
    92→	scanStartTime := time.Now()
    93→	allRecords := []JSONLRecord{}
    94→	err := filepath.Walk(projectPath, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
    95→		if err != nil {
    96→			return err
    97→		}
    98→		if info.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".jsonl") {
    99→			return nil
   100→		}
   101→		if sessionID != "" {
   102→			foundSessionID, matchErr := extractSessionIDFromFile(path)
   103→			if matchErr != nil {
   104→				slog.Warn("ParseProjectSessions: Failed to check session ID, parsing anyway",
   105→					"file", path,
   106→					"error", matchErr)
   107→			} else if foundSessionID != sessionID {
   108→				return nil
   109→			}
   110→		}
   111→		records, err := p.parseSessionFile(path)
   112→		if err != nil {
   113→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse file %s: %w", path, err)
   114→		}
   115→		allRecords = append(allRecords, records...)
   116→		// Print progress dot for each file when not in silent mode
   117→		NoteProgress(silent)
   118→		return nil
   119→	})
   120→
   121→	if err != nil {
   122→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to scan project directory %s: %w", projectPath, err)
   123→	}
   124→	scanDuration := time.Since(scanStartTime)
   125→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: File scanning completed", "duration", formatDuration(scanDuration), "records", len(allRecords))
   126→
   127→	if !silent {
   128→		fmt.Print("\nProcessing JSONL files")
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Step 2: Eliminate duplicates by uuid (keep earliest by timestamp)
   132→	dedupStartTime := time.Now()
   133→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Eliminating duplicates", "records", len(allRecords))
   134→	uniqueRecords := p.eliminateDuplicates(allRecords)
   135→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: After deduplication", "uniqueRecords", len(uniqueRecords))
   136→	dedupDuration := time.Since(dedupStartTime)
   137→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Deduplication completed", "duration", formatDuration(dedupDuration))
   138→
   139→	NoteProgress(silent)
   140→
   141→	// Store all records for searching
   142→	p.Records = uniqueRecords
   143→
   144→	NoteProgress(silent)
   145→
   146→	// Step 3: Build parent/child DAGs
   147→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Building DAGs")
   148→	dagStartTime := time.Now()
   149→	dags := p.buildDAGs(uniqueRecords)
   150→	dagDuration := time.Since(dagStartTime)
   151→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: DAG building completed", "duration", formatDuration(dagDuration), "dagCount", len(dags))
   152→
   153→	// Step 4: Merge DAGs with the same session ID (handles resumed sessions)
   154→	mergeStartTime := time.Now()
   155→	mergedDags := p.mergeDagsWithSameSessionId(dags)
   156→	mergeDuration := time.Since(mergeStartTime)
   157→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: DAG merging completed", "duration", formatDuration(mergeDuration),
   158→		"beforeCount", len(dags), "afterCount", len(mergedDags))
   159→
   160→	// Step 5: Flatten each DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
   161→	flattenStartTime := time.Now()
   162→	sessions := []Session{}
   163→	for _, dag := range mergedDags {
   164→		NoteProgress(silent)
   165→		flattenedDAG := p.flattenDAG(dag)
   166→		if len(flattenedDAG) == 0 {
   167→			continue
   168→		}
   169→
   170→		// Step 6: The session is the sessionId of the head
   171→		sessionId := ""
   172→		if sid, ok := flattenedDAG[0].Data["sessionId"].(string); ok {
   173→			sessionId = sid
   174→		} else {
   175→			// If head doesn't have sessionId, find first one in the array
   176→			for _, record := range flattenedDAG {
   177→				if sid, ok := record.Data["sessionId"].(string); ok {
   178→					sessionId = sid
   179→					break
   180→				}
   181→			}
   182→		}
   183→
   184→		// Skip if no valid sessionId found
   185→		if sessionId == "" {
   186→			slog.Debug("Skipping DAG with no valid sessionId")
   187→			continue
   188→		}
   189→
   190→		// Log session creation details
   191→		if len(flattenedDAG) > 0 {
   192→			rootTimestamp := ""
   193→			if ts, ok := flattenedDAG[0].Data["timestamp"].(string); ok {
   194→				rootTimestamp = ts
   195→			}
   196→			slog.Debug("Creating session",
   197→				"sessionId", sessionId,
   198→				"rootTimestamp", rootTimestamp,
   199→				"recordCount", len(flattenedDAG))
   200→		}
   201→
   202→		sessions = append(sessions, Session{
   203→			SessionUuid: sessionId,
   204→			Records:     flattenedDAG,
   205→		})
   206→	}
   207→
   208→	p.Sessions = sessions
   209→	flattenDuration := time.Since(flattenStartTime)
   210→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Flattening completed", "duration", formatDuration(flattenDuration))
   211→
   212→	// Log total parsing time
   213→	totalDuration := time.Since(parseStartTime)
   214→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: Completed parsing", "sessions", len(p.Sessions), "duration", formatDuration(totalDuration))
   215→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Performance breakdown",
   216→		"scan", formatDuration(scanDuration),
   217→		"dedup", formatDuration(dedupDuration),
   218→		"dag", formatDuration(dagDuration),
   219→		"flatten", formatDuration(flattenDuration))
   220→	return nil
   221→}
   222→
   223→func NoteProgress(silent bool) {
   224→	if !silent {
   225→		fmt.Print(".")
   226→		_ = os.Stdout.Sync()
   227→	}
   228→}
   229→
   230→// extractSessionIDFromFile reads a JSONL file and returns the first sessionId found.
   231→// Uses regex for fast extraction without full JSON parsing.
   232→// Returns empty string if no sessionId is found.
   233→func extractSessionIDFromFile(filePath string) (string, error) {
   234→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   235→	if err != nil {
   236→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open file: %w", err)
   237→	}
   238→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }()
   239→
   240→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   241→
   242→	for {
   243→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   244→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   245→			return "", fmt.Errorf("error reading file: %w", err)
   246→		}
   247→
   248→		// Try to find sessionId via regex (faster than JSON parsing)
   249→		if matches := sessionIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(matches) > 1 {
   250→			return matches[1], nil
   251→		}
   252→
   253→		if err == io.EOF {
   254→			break
   255→		}
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	return "", nil
   259→}
   260→
   261→// ParseSingleSession parses sessions and filters to a specific UUID
   262→func (p *JSONLParser) ParseSingleSession(projectPath string, sessionUuid string) error {
   263→	// Parse only files matching this session (silent=true since this is for single session)
   264→	if err := p.ParseProjectSessionsForSession(projectPath, true, sessionUuid); err != nil {
   265→		return err
   266→	}
   267→
   268→	// Filter to just the requested session
   269→	filteredSessions := []Session{}
   270→	for _, session := range p.Sessions {
   271→		if session.SessionUuid == sessionUuid {
   272→			filteredSessions = append(filteredSessions, session)
   273→		}
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	if len(filteredSessions) == 0 {
   277→		return fmt.Errorf("no session found for UUID %s", sessionUuid)
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	p.Sessions = filteredSessions
   281→	return nil
   282→}
   283→
   284→// parseSessionFile parses a single JSONL file and handles summaries and sidechains
   285→func (p *JSONLParser) parseSessionFile(filePath string) ([]JSONLRecord, error) {
   286→	slog.Info("Parsing session file", "file", filePath)
   287→
   288→	// Clean debug directory for jsonl-burst mode only
   289→	// (specstory-burst cleaning happens later during markdown generation)
   290→	if GetJsonlBurst() {
   291→		uuid := ExtractUUIDFromFilename(filePath)
   292→		if err := CleanDebugDirectory(uuid); err != nil {
   293→			slog.Warn("Failed to clean debug directory", "error", err)
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   298→	if err != nil {
   299→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open file: %w", err)
   300→	}
   301→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }() // Read-only file; close errors not actionable
   302→
   303→	// Use bufio.Reader instead of Scanner to handle arbitrarily large lines
   304→	// Scanner has a token size limit (even with custom buffer), but Reader does not
   305→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   306→
   307→	lineNumber := 0
   308→	records := []JSONLRecord{}
   309→	var lastNonSummaryRecord *JSONLRecord
   310→	// pendingSummary holds a summary string when it appears before any records in the file.
   311→	// This happens when the summary is on line 1 - we can't attach it to a previous record
   312→	// because none exists yet, so we hold it and attach it to the next record we process.
   313→	var pendingSummary string
   314→
   315→	for {
   316→		// Read line using ReadString which has no size limit
   317→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   318→		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
   319→
   320→		// EOF is expected at end of file, other errors are genuine failures
   321→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   322→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("error reading line %d: %w", lineNumber+1, err)
   323→		}
   324→
   325→		// Determine if we're at end of file and if we have content to process
   326→		atEOF := err == io.EOF
   327→		hasContent := len(line) > 0
   328→
   329→		// Increment line number for every line read (including empty lines) to match text editor line numbers
   330→		if hasContent || !atEOF {
   331→			lineNumber++
   332→		}
   333→
   334→		// If no content, either skip empty line or exit at EOF
   335→		if !hasContent {
   336→			if atEOF {
   337→				break // Reached end of file with no content
   338→			}
   339→			continue // Empty line in middle of file, skip it
   340→		}
   341→
   342→		// Sanity check to prevent OOM from pathological files
   343→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   344→			slog.Warn("line exceeds reasonable size limit",
   345→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   346→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   347→				"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB,
   348→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath))
   349→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB): refusing to process potentially malformed file",
   350→				lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
   351→		}
   352→
   353→		// Log when processing unusually large lines (helps debug performance issues)
   354→		if len(line) > 10*MB {
   355→			slog.Debug("processing large JSONL line",
   356→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   357→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   358→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath))
   359→		}
   360→
   361→		var data map[string]interface{}
   362→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &data); err != nil {
   363→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON on line %d: %w", lineNumber, err)
   364→		}
   365→
   366→		// Write debug JSON if jsonl-burst mode is enabled
   367→		_ = WriteDebugJSON(filePath, lineNumber, data) // Debug feature; errors don't affect parsing
   368→
   369→		// Check if this is a summary line
   370→		if data["type"] == "summary" {
   371→			if len(records) > 0 && lastNonSummaryRecord != nil {
   372→				// Add summary to the last non-summary record
   373→				lastNonSummaryRecord.Data["summary"] = data
   374→			} else {
   375→				// No previous record exists (summary is on line 1), so store it for the next record
   376→				if summaryText, ok := data["summary"].(string); ok {
   377→					pendingSummary = summaryText
   378→				}
   379→			}
   380→			// After processing summary, check if we're done
   381→			if atEOF {
   382→				break
   383→			}
   384→			continue // Don't add summary as a separate record
   385→		}
   386→
   387→		// Handle sidechain parentUuid update
   388→		if isSidechain, ok := data["isSidechain"].(bool); ok && isSidechain {
   389→			if data["parentUuid"] == nil && lastNonSummaryRecord != nil {
   390→				// Update parentUuid to the uuid of the prior record
   391→				if uuid, ok := lastNonSummaryRecord.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
   392→					data["parentUuid"] = uuid
   393→				}
   394→			}
   395→		}
   396→
   397→		// If we have a pending summary from line 1, attach it to this first record
   398→		if pendingSummary != "" {
   399→			data["summary"] = map[string]interface{}{
   400→				"summary": pendingSummary,
   401→			}
   402→			pendingSummary = "" // Clear it so we don't attach to multiple records
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		record := JSONLRecord{
   406→			Data: data,
   407→			File: filePath,
   408→			Line: lineNumber,
   409→		}
   410→
   411→		records = append(records, record)
   412→
   413→		// Track last non-summary record for sidechain processing
   414→		if data["uuid"] != nil {
   415→			lastNonSummaryRecord = &record
   416→		}
   417→
   418→		// After processing record, check if we're done
   419→		if atEOF {
   420→			break
   421→		}
   422→	}
   423→
   424→	return records, nil
   425→}
   426→
   427→// eliminateDuplicates removes duplicate records by uuid, keeping the earliest by timestamp
   428→func (p *JSONLParser) eliminateDuplicates(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   429→	// Map to track records by uuid
   430→	recordMap := make(map[string]JSONLRecord)
   431→
   432→	for _, record := range records {
   433→		uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
   434→		if !ok || uuid == "" {
   435→			// Skip records without uuid
   436→			continue
   437→		}
   438→
   439→		// If we haven't seen this uuid before, add it
   440→		if existing, exists := recordMap[uuid]; !exists {
   441→			recordMap[uuid] = record
   442→		} else {
   443→			// Compare timestamps and keep the earliest
   444→			existingTS, _ := existing.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   445→			currentTS, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   446→			if currentTS < existingTS {
   447→				slog.Debug("eliminateDuplicates: Duplicate uuid - keeping newer timestamp",
   448→					"uuid", uuid,
   449→					"newTimestamp", currentTS,
   450→					"oldTimestamp", existingTS)
   451→				recordMap[uuid] = record
   452→			} else if currentTS != existingTS {
   453→				slog.Debug("eliminateDuplicates: Duplicate uuid - keeping older timestamp",
   454→					"uuid", uuid,
   455→					"oldTimestamp", existingTS,
   456→					"newTimestamp", currentTS)
   457→			}
   458→		}
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Convert map back to slice
   462→	uniqueRecords := make([]JSONLRecord, 0, len(recordMap))
   463→	for _, record := range recordMap {
   464→		uniqueRecords = append(uniqueRecords, record)
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	// Sort by timestamp for deterministic order
   468→	sort.Slice(uniqueRecords, func(i, j int) bool {
   469→		tsI, _ := uniqueRecords[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   470→		tsJ, _ := uniqueRecords[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   471→		return tsI < tsJ
   472→	})
   473→
   474→	return uniqueRecords
   475→}
   476→
   477→// mergeDagsWithSameSessionId merges DAGs that have the same session ID
   478→// This handles cases where Claude Code resumes a session, creating multiple roots for the same session
   479→func (p *JSONLParser) mergeDagsWithSameSessionId(dags [][]JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
   480→	// Map to group DAGs by session ID
   481→	sessionDagMap := make(map[string][][]JSONLRecord)
   482→
   483→	for _, dag := range dags {
   484→		if len(dag) == 0 {
   485→			continue
   486→		}
   487→
   488→		// Find the session ID for this DAG
   489→		sessionId := ""
   490→		for _, record := range dag {
   491→			if sid, ok := record.Data["sessionId"].(string); ok && sid != "" {
   492→				sessionId = sid
   493→				break
   494→			}
   495→		}
   496→
   497→		// If no session ID found, treat it as a unique DAG
   498→		if sessionId == "" {
   499→			sessionId = fmt.Sprintf("no-session-%p", &dag)
   500→		}
   501→
   502→		sessionDagMap[sessionId] = append(sessionDagMap[sessionId], dag)
   503→	}
   504→
   505→	// Merge DAGs with the same session ID
   506→	mergedDags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
   507→	for sessionId, dagsForSession := range sessionDagMap {
   508→		if len(dagsForSession) == 1 {
   509→			// No merging needed
   510→			mergedDags = append(mergedDags, dagsForSession[0])
   511→		} else {
   512→			// Merge multiple DAGs for the same session
   513→			slog.Debug("Merging multiple DAGs for session", "sessionId", sessionId, "dagCount", len(dagsForSession))
   514→			mergedDag := []JSONLRecord{}
   515→			for _, dag := range dagsForSession {
   516→				mergedDag = append(mergedDag, dag...)
   517→			}
   518→			mergedDags = append(mergedDags, mergedDag)
   519→		}
   520→	}
   521→
   522→	return mergedDags
   523→}
   524→
   525→// buildDAGs constructs parent/child DAGs from records
   526→func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGs(records []JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
   527→	// Create a map for quick lookup by uuid
   528→	recordByUuid := make(map[string]JSONLRecord)
   529→	for _, record := range records {
   530→		if uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
   531→			recordByUuid[uuid] = record
   532→		}
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	// Find all root nodes (parentUuid == null)
   536→	roots := []JSONLRecord{}
   537→	for _, record := range records {
   538→		if record.Data["parentUuid"] == nil {
   539→			roots = append(roots, record)
   540→		}
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Build a DAG for each root
   544→	dags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
   545→	for _, root := range roots {
   546→		dag := p.buildDAGFromRoot(root, recordByUuid)
   547→		if len(dag) > 0 {
   548→			dags = append(dags, dag)
   549→		}
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	return dags
   553→}
   554→
   555→// buildDAGFromRoot builds a DAG starting from a root node
   556→func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGFromRoot(root JSONLRecord, recordByUuid map[string]JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   557→	dag := []JSONLRecord{}
   558→	visited := make(map[string]bool)
   559→
   560→	var traverse func(node JSONLRecord)
   561→	traverse = func(node JSONLRecord) {
   562→		uuid, ok := node.Data["uuid"].(string)
   563→		if !ok || visited[uuid] {
   564→			return
   565→		}
   566→
   567→		visited[uuid] = true
   568→		dag = append(dag, node)
   569→
   570→		// Find all children and collect them first
   571→		children := []JSONLRecord{}
   572→		for _, record := range recordByUuid {
   573→			parentUuid, ok := record.Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   574→			if ok && parentUuid == uuid {
   575→				// Check if this child exists in our map (to handle orphans)
   576→				if _, exists := recordByUuid[record.Data["uuid"].(string)]; exists {
   577→					children = append(children, record)
   578→				}
   579→			}
   580→		}
   581→
   582→		// Sort children by timestamp for deterministic traversal order
   583→		sort.Slice(children, func(i, j int) bool {
   584→			tsI, _ := children[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   585→			tsJ, _ := children[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   586→			return tsI < tsJ
   587→		})
   588→
   589→		// Traverse children in sorted order
   590→		for _, child := range children {
   591→			traverse(child)
   592→		}
   593→	}
   594→
   595→	traverse(root)
   596→	return dag
   597→}
   598→
   599→// flattenDAG flattens a DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
   600→func (p *JSONLParser) flattenDAG(dag []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   601→	// Sort by timestamp, with parent-child relationships as tiebreaker
   602→	sort.Slice(dag, func(i, j int) bool {
   603→		tsI, _ := dag[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   604→		tsJ, _ := dag[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   605→		if tsI != tsJ {
   606→			return tsI < tsJ
   607→		}
   608→		// If timestamps are equal, check parent-child relationship
   609→		uuidI, _ := dag[i].Data["uuid"].(string)
   610→		uuidJ, _ := dag[j].Data["uuid"].(string)
   611→		parentI, _ := dag[i].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   612→		parentJ, _ := dag[j].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   613→
   614→		// If j is the parent of i, j should come first
   615→		if parentI == uuidJ {
   616→			return false
   617→		}
   618→		// If i is the parent of j, i should come first
   619→		if parentJ == uuidI {
   620→			return true
   621→		}
   622→		// Otherwise, sort by UUID for deterministic ordering
   623→		return uuidI < uuidJ
   624→	})
   625→
   626→	return dag
   627→}
   628→
   629→// FindSession returns a pointer to the session with the given UUID
   630→func (p *JSONLParser) FindSession(sessionUuid string) *Session {
   631→	for i := range p.Sessions {
   632→		if p.Sessions[i].SessionUuid == sessionUuid {
   633→			return &p.Sessions[i]
   634→		}
   635→	}
   636→	return nil
   637→}
   638→
   639→// FindRecord returns a pointer to the first record that matches the given filter function
   640→func (p *JSONLParser) FindRecord(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) *JSONLRecord {
   641→	for i := range p.Records {
   642→		if filter(p.Records[i]) {
   643→			return &p.Records[i]
   644→		}
   645→	}
   646→	return nil
   647→}
   648→
   649→// FilterRecords returns records that match the given filter function
   650→func (p *JSONLParser) FilterRecords(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) []JSONLRecord {
   651→	var filtered []JSONLRecord
   652→	for _, record := range p.Records {
   653→		if filter(record) {
   654→			filtered = append(filtered, record)
   655→		}
   656→	}
   657→	return filtered
   658→}
   659→
   660→// Count returns the total number of parsed records
   661→func (p *JSONLParser) Count() int {
   662→	return len(p.Records)
   663→}
   664→

Perfect! Now I have a comprehensive understanding of all the providers. Let me create a summary report.

## Provider Data Source Summary

Based on my exploration of the `pkg/providers` directory, here's a comprehensive analysis of all five providers and their data source types:

### 1. **Claude Code** (claudecode)
- **Data Source Type:** JSONL (JSON Lines)
- **Location:** `~/.claude/projects/<dir-derived-from-project-dir>/<session-id>.jsonl`
- **Key Implementation:** `jsonl_parser.go` - Sophisticated JSONL parsing with:
  - Parent/child DAG construction from UUIDs and parentUuids
  - Deduplication by UUID (keeping earliest timestamp)
  - Support for summaries and sidechains
  - Merging of DAGs for resumed sessions
  - Warmup message filtering

### 2. **Codex CLI** (codexcli)
- **Data Source Type:** JSONL (JSON Lines)
- **Location:** `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/*.jsonl`
- **Key Implementation:** `provider.go` - Direct JSONL reading with:
  - Session metadata as first line (session_meta record type)
  - Line-by-line parsing using `bufio.Reader` for arbitrarily large lines
  - 250MB sanity limit per line to prevent OOM
  - Metadata extraction (ID, timestamp, CWD)

### 3. **Cursor CLI** (cursorcli)
- **Data Source Type:** SQLite Database (binary)
- **Location:** `~/.cursor/chats/<project-hash>/<session-id>/store.db`
- **Key Implementation:** `sqlite_reader.go` - SQLite database reading with:
  - Uses pure Go SQLite driver (`modernc.org/sqlite`)
  - Reads blob records from database (structured binary data)
  - Parses JSON from blob data
  - Uses DAG sorting for message ordering
  - Handles orphaned records

### 4. **Factory Droid CLI** (droidcli)
- **Data Source Type:** JSONL (JSON Lines)
- **Location:** `~/.factory/sessions/*.jsonl`
- **Key Implementation:** `parser.go` - JSONL parsing with:
  - Session start events (type: "session_start")
  - Message events with rich metadata
  - Todo and compaction events
  - Project path extraction from workspace_root field
  - Line-by-line scanning using custom `scanLines` function

### 5. **Gemini CLI** (geminicli)
- **Data Source Type:** JSON (individual files) + logs.json
- **Location:** `~/.gemini/tmp/<project-hash>/chats/*.json` and `logs.json`
- **Key Implementation:** `json_parser.go` - JSON file parsing with:
  - Separate JSON files per session (not JSONL)
  - Messages stored in "messages" array
  - Tool calls, thoughts, and token usage tracking
  - Logs stored separately in `logs.json`
  - File discovery using directory scanning

### Summary Table

| Provider | Data Format | Data Source | Location Type | Parser Complexity |
|----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|------------------|
| Claude Code | JSONL | JSONL Files | Project-specific dir | High (DAGs, dedup, merge) |
| Codex CLI | JSONL | JSONL Files | Date-based tree | Medium (line parsing) |
| Cursor CLI | SQLite | Binary Database | Hashed directory | High (SQL queries, binary blobs) |
| Factory Droid | JSONL | JSONL Files | Root-level sessions | Medium (event-based) |
| Gemini CLI | JSON | JSON Files | Hashed chats dir | Medium (file discovery) |

### JSONL-Specific Providers
Three providers specifically parse JSONL files:
1. **Claude Code** - Most sophisticated JSONL processing
2. **Codex CLI** - Direct line-based JSONL reading
3. **Factory Droid** - Event-based JSONL parsing

The key difference is how each handles the JSONL structure and what metadata they extract from the JSON objects.

    86→func (p *JSONLParser) parseProjectSessions(projectPath string, silent bool, sessionID string) error {
    87→	// Track overall parsing time
    88→	parseStartTime := time.Now()
    89→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: Starting JSONL parsing")
    90→
    91→	// Step 1: Scan all JSONL files
    92→	scanStartTime := time.Now()
    93→	allRecords := []JSONLRecord{}
    94→	err := filepath.Walk(projectPath, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
    95→		if err != nil {
    96→			return err
    97→		}
    98→		if info.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".jsonl") {
    99→			return nil
   100→		}
   101→		if sessionID != "" {
   102→			foundSessionID, matchErr := extractSessionIDFromFile(path)
   103→			if matchErr != nil {
   104→				slog.Warn("ParseProjectSessions: Failed to check session ID, parsing anyway",
   105→					"file", path,
   106→					"error", matchErr)
   107→			} else if foundSessionID != sessionID {
   108→				return nil
   109→			}
   110→		}
   111→		records, err := p.parseSessionFile(path)
   112→		if err != nil {
   113→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse file %s: %w", path, err)
   114→		}
   115→		allRecords = append(allRecords, records...)
   116→		// Print progress dot for each file when not in silent mode
   117→		NoteProgress(silent)
   118→		return nil
   119→	})
   120→
   121→	if err != nil {
   122→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to scan project directory %s: %w", projectPath, err)
   123→	}
   124→	scanDuration := time.Since(scanStartTime)
   125→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: File scanning completed", "duration", formatDuration(scanDuration), "records", len(allRecords))
   126→
   127→	if !silent {
   128→		fmt.Print("\nProcessing JSONL files")
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Step 2: Eliminate duplicates by uuid (keep earliest by timestamp)
   132→	dedupStartTime := time.Now()
   133→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Eliminating duplicates", "records", len(allRecords))
   134→	uniqueRecords := p.eliminateDuplicates(allRecords)
   135→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: After deduplication", "uniqueRecords", len(uniqueRecords))
   136→	dedupDuration := time.Since(dedupStartTime)
   137→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Deduplication completed", "duration", formatDuration(dedupDuration))
   138→
   139→	NoteProgress(silent)
   140→
   141→	// Store all records for searching
   142→	p.Records = uniqueRecords
   143→
   144→	NoteProgress(silent)
   145→
   146→	// Step 3: Build parent/child DAGs
   147→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Building DAGs")
   148→	dagStartTime := time.Now()
   149→	dags := p.buildDAGs(uniqueRecords)
   150→	dagDuration := time.Since(dagStartTime)
   151→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: DAG building completed", "duration", formatDuration(dagDuration), "dagCount", len(dags))
   152→
   153→	// Step 4: Merge DAGs with the same session ID (handles resumed sessions)
   154→	mergeStartTime := time.Now()
   155→	mergedDags := p.mergeDagsWithSameSessionId(dags)
   156→	mergeDuration := time.Since(mergeStartTime)
   157→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: DAG merging completed", "duration", formatDuration(mergeDuration),
   158→		"beforeCount", len(dags), "afterCount", len(mergedDags))
   159→
   160→	// Step 5: Flatten each DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
   161→	flattenStartTime := time.Now()
   162→	sessions := []Session{}
   163→	for _, dag := range mergedDags {
   164→		NoteProgress(silent)
   165→		flattenedDAG := p.flattenDAG(dag)
   166→		if len(flattenedDAG) == 0 {
   167→			continue
   168→		}
   169→
   170→		// Step 6: The session is the sessionId of the head
   171→		sessionId := ""
   172→		if sid, ok := flattenedDAG[0].Data["sessionId"].(string); ok {
   173→			sessionId = sid
   174→		} else {
   175→			// If head doesn't have sessionId, find first one in the array
   176→			for _, record := range flattenedDAG {
   177→				if sid, ok := record.Data["sessionId"].(string); ok {
   178→					sessionId = sid
   179→					break
   180→				}
   181→			}
   182→		}
   183→
   184→		// Skip if no valid sessionId found
   185→		if sessionId == "" {
   186→			slog.Debug("Skipping DAG with no valid sessionId")
   187→			continue
   188→		}
   189→
   190→		// Log session creation details
   191→		if len(flattenedDAG) > 0 {
   192→			rootTimestamp := ""
   193→			if ts, ok := flattenedDAG[0].Data["timestamp"].(string); ok {
   194→				rootTimestamp = ts
   195→			}
   196→			slog.Debug("Creating session",
   197→				"sessionId", sessionId,
   198→				"rootTimestamp", rootTimestamp,
   199→				"recordCount", len(flattenedDAG))
   200→		}
   201→
   202→		sessions = append(sessions, Session{
   203→			SessionUuid: sessionId,
   204→			Records:     flattenedDAG,
   205→		})
   206→	}
   207→
   208→	p.Sessions = sessions
   209→	flattenDuration := time.Since(flattenStartTime)
   210→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Flattening completed", "duration", formatDuration(flattenDuration))
   211→
   212→	// Log total parsing time
   213→	totalDuration := time.Since(parseStartTime)
   214→	slog.Info("ParseProjectSessions: Completed parsing", "sessions", len(p.Sessions), "duration", formatDuration(totalDuration))
   215→	slog.Debug("ParseProjectSessions: Performance breakdown",
   216→		"scan", formatDuration(scanDuration),
   217→		"dedup", formatDuration(dedupDuration),
   218→		"dag", formatDuration(dagDuration),
   219→		"flatten", formatDuration(flattenDuration))
   220→	return nil
   221→}
   222→
   223→func NoteProgress(silent bool) {
   224→	if !silent {
   225→		fmt.Print(".")
   226→		_ = os.Stdout.Sync()
   227→	}
   228→}
   229→
   230→// extractSessionIDFromFile reads a JSONL file and returns the first sessionId found.
   231→// Uses regex for fast extraction without full JSON parsing.
   232→// Returns empty string if no sessionId is found.
   233→func extractSessionIDFromFile(filePath string) (string, error) {
   234→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   235→	if err != nil {
   236→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open file: %w", err)
   237→	}
   238→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }()
   239→
   240→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   241→
   242→	for {
   243→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   244→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   245→			return "", fmt.Errorf("error reading file: %w", err)
   246→		}
   247→
   248→		// Try to find sessionId via regex (faster than JSON parsing)
   249→		if matches := sessionIDRegex.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(matches) > 1 {
   250→			return matches[1], nil
   251→		}
   252→
   253→		if err == io.EOF {
   254→			break
   255→		}
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	return "", nil
   259→}
   260→
   261→// ParseSingleSession parses sessions and filters to a specific UUID
   262→func (p *JSONLParser) ParseSingleSession(projectPath string, sessionUuid string) error {
   263→	// Parse only files matching this session (silent=true since this is for single session)
   264→	if err := p.ParseProjectSessionsForSession(projectPath, true, sessionUuid); err != nil {
   265→		return err
   266→	}
   267→
   268→	// Filter to just the requested session
   269→	filteredSessions := []Session{}
   270→	for _, session := range p.Sessions {
   271→		if session.SessionUuid == sessionUuid {
   272→			filteredSessions = append(filteredSessions, session)
   273→		}
   274→	}
   275→
   276→	if len(filteredSessions) == 0 {
   277→		return fmt.Errorf("no session found for UUID %s", sessionUuid)
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	p.Sessions = filteredSessions
   281→	return nil
   282→}
   283→
   284→// parseSessionFile parses a single JSONL file and handles summaries and sidechains
   285→func (p *JSONLParser) parseSessionFile(filePath string) ([]JSONLRecord, error) {
   286→	slog.Info("Parsing session file", "file", filePath)
   287→
   288→	// Clean debug directory for jsonl-burst mode only
   289→	// (specstory-burst cleaning happens later during markdown generation)
   290→	if GetJsonlBurst() {
   291→		uuid := ExtractUUIDFromFilename(filePath)
   292→		if err := CleanDebugDirectory(uuid); err != nil {
   293→			slog.Warn("Failed to clean debug directory", "error", err)
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
   298→	if err != nil {
   299→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open file: %w", err)
   300→	}
   301→	defer func() { _ = file.Close() }() // Read-only file; close errors not actionable
   302→
   303→	// Use bufio.Reader instead of Scanner to handle arbitrarily large lines
   304→	// Scanner has a token size limit (even with custom buffer), but Reader does not
   305→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   306→
   307→	lineNumber := 0
   308→	records := []JSONLRecord{}
   309→	var lastNonSummaryRecord *JSONLRecord
   310→	// pendingSummary holds a summary string when it appears before any records in the file.
   311→	// This happens when the summary is on line 1 - we can't attach it to a previous record
   312→	// because none exists yet, so we hold it and attach it to the next record we process.
   313→	var pendingSummary string
   314→
   315→	for {
   316→		// Read line using ReadString which has no size limit
   317→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   318→		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
   319→
   320→		// EOF is expected at end of file, other errors are genuine failures
   321→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   322→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("error reading line %d: %w", lineNumber+1, err)
   323→		}
   324→
   325→		// Determine if we're at end of file and if we have content to process
   326→		atEOF := err == io.EOF
   327→		hasContent := len(line) > 0
   328→
   329→		// Increment line number for every line read (including empty lines) to match text editor line numbers
   330→		if hasContent || !atEOF {
   331→			lineNumber++
   332→		}
   333→
   334→		// If no content, either skip empty line or exit at EOF
   335→		if !hasContent {
   336→			if atEOF {
   337→				break // Reached end of file with no content
   338→			}
   339→			continue // Empty line in middle of file, skip it
   340→		}
   341→
   342→		// Sanity check to prevent OOM from pathological files
   343→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   344→			slog.Warn("line exceeds reasonable size limit",
   345→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   346→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   347→				"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB,
   348→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath))
   349→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB): refusing to process potentially malformed file",
   350→				lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
   351→		}
   352→
   353→		// Log when processing unusually large lines (helps debug performance issues)
   354→		if len(line) > 10*MB {
   355→			slog.Debug("processing large JSONL line",
   356→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   357→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   358→				"file", filepath.Base(filePath))
   359→		}
   360→
   361→		var data map[string]interface{}
   362→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &data); err != nil {
   363→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON on line %d: %w", lineNumber, err)
   364→		}
   365→
   366→		// Write debug JSON if jsonl-burst mode is enabled
   367→		_ = WriteDebugJSON(filePath, lineNumber, data) // Debug feature; errors don't affect parsing
   368→
   369→		// Check if this is a summary line
   370→		if data["type"] == "summary" {
   371→			if len(records) > 0 && lastNonSummaryRecord != nil {
   372→				// Add summary to the last non-summary record
   373→				lastNonSummaryRecord.Data["summary"] = data
   374→			} else {
   375→				// No previous record exists (summary is on line 1), so store it for the next record
   376→				if summaryText, ok := data["summary"].(string); ok {
   377→					pendingSummary = summaryText
   378→				}
   379→			}
   380→			// After processing summary, check if we're done
   381→			if atEOF {
   382→				break
   383→			}
   384→			continue // Don't add summary as a separate record
   385→		}
   386→
   387→		// Handle sidechain parentUuid update
   388→		if isSidechain, ok := data["isSidechain"].(bool); ok && isSidechain {
   389→			if data["parentUuid"] == nil && lastNonSummaryRecord != nil {
   390→				// Update parentUuid to the uuid of the prior record
   391→				if uuid, ok := lastNonSummaryRecord.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
   392→					data["parentUuid"] = uuid
   393→				}
   394→			}
   395→		}
   396→
   397→		// If we have a pending summary from line 1, attach it to this first record
   398→		if pendingSummary != "" {
   399→			data["summary"] = map[string]interface{}{
   400→				"summary": pendingSummary,
   401→			}
   402→			pendingSummary = "" // Clear it so we don't attach to multiple records
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		record := JSONLRecord{
   406→			Data: data,
   407→			File: filePath,
   408→			Line: lineNumber,
   409→		}
   410→
   411→		records = append(records, record)
   412→
   413→		// Track last non-summary record for sidechain processing
   414→		if data["uuid"] != nil {
   415→			lastNonSummaryRecord = &record
   416→		}
   417→
   418→		// After processing record, check if we're done
   419→		if atEOF {
   420→			break
   421→		}
   422→	}
   423→
   424→	return records, nil
   425→}
   426→
   427→// eliminateDuplicates removes duplicate records by uuid, keeping the earliest by timestamp
   428→func (p *JSONLParser) eliminateDuplicates(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   429→	// Map to track records by uuid
   430→	recordMap := make(map[string]JSONLRecord)
   431→
   432→	for _, record := range records {
   433→		uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
   434→		if !ok || uuid == "" {
   435→			// Skip records without uuid
   436→			continue
   437→		}
   438→
   439→		// If we haven't seen this uuid before, add it
   440→		if existing, exists := recordMap[uuid]; !exists {
   441→			recordMap[uuid] = record
   442→		} else {
   443→			// Compare timestamps and keep the earliest
   444→			existingTS, _ := existing.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   445→			currentTS, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
   446→			if currentTS < existingTS {
   447→				slog.Debug("eliminateDuplicates: Duplicate uuid - keeping newer timestamp",
   448→					"uuid", uuid,
   449→					"newTimestamp", currentTS,
   450→					"oldTimestamp", existingTS)
   451→				recordMap[uuid] = record
   452→			} else if currentTS != existingTS {
   453→				slog.Debug("eliminateDuplicates: Duplicate uuid - keeping older timestamp",
   454→					"uuid", uuid,
   455→					"oldTimestamp", existingTS,
   456→					"newTimestamp", currentTS)
   457→			}
   458→		}
   459→	}
   460→
   461→	// Convert map back to slice
   462→	uniqueRecords := make([]JSONLRecord, 0, len(recordMap))
   463→	for _, record := range recordMap {
   464→		uniqueRecords = append(uniqueRecords, record)
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	// Sort by timestamp for deterministic order
   468→	sort.Slice(uniqueRecords, func(i, j int) bool {
   469→		tsI, _ := uniqueRecords[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   470→		tsJ, _ := uniqueRecords[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   471→		return tsI < tsJ
   472→	})
   473→
   474→	return uniqueRecords
   475→}
   476→
   477→// mergeDagsWithSameSessionId merges DAGs that have the same session ID
   478→// This handles cases where Claude Code resumes a session, creating multiple roots for the same session
   479→func (p *JSONLParser) mergeDagsWithSameSessionId(dags [][]JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
   480→	// Map to group DAGs by session ID
   481→	sessionDagMap := make(map[string][][]JSONLRecord)
   482→
   483→	for _, dag := range dags {
   484→		if len(dag) == 0 {
   485→			continue
   486→		}
   487→
   488→		// Find the session ID for this DAG
   489→		sessionId := ""
   490→		for _, record := range dag {
   491→			if sid, ok := record.Data["sessionId"].(string); ok && sid != "" {
   492→				sessionId = sid
   493→				break
   494→			}
   495→		}
   496→
   497→		// If no session ID found, treat it as a unique DAG
   498→		if sessionId == "" {
   499→			sessionId = fmt.Sprintf("no-session-%p", &dag)
   500→		}
   501→
   502→		sessionDagMap[sessionId] = append(sessionDagMap[sessionId], dag)
   503→	}
   504→
   505→	// Merge DAGs with the same session ID
   506→	mergedDags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
   507→	for sessionId, dagsForSession := range sessionDagMap {
   508→		if len(dagsForSession) == 1 {
   509→			// No merging needed
   510→			mergedDags = append(mergedDags, dagsForSession[0])
   511→		} else {
   512→			// Merge multiple DAGs for the same session
   513→			slog.Debug("Merging multiple DAGs for session", "sessionId", sessionId, "dagCount", len(dagsForSession))
   514→			mergedDag := []JSONLRecord{}
   515→			for _, dag := range dagsForSession {
   516→				mergedDag = append(mergedDag, dag...)
   517→			}
   518→			mergedDags = append(mergedDags, mergedDag)
   519→		}
   520→	}
   521→
   522→	return mergedDags
   523→}
   524→
   525→// buildDAGs constructs parent/child DAGs from records
   526→func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGs(records []JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
   527→	// Create a map for quick lookup by uuid
   528→	recordByUuid := make(map[string]JSONLRecord)
   529→	for _, record := range records {
   530→		if uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
   531→			recordByUuid[uuid] = record
   532→		}
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	// Find all root nodes (parentUuid == null)
   536→	roots := []JSONLRecord{}
   537→	for _, record := range records {
   538→		if record.Data["parentUuid"] == nil {
   539→			roots = append(roots, record)
   540→		}
   541→	}
   542→
   543→	// Build a DAG for each root
   544→	dags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
   545→	for _, root := range roots {
   546→		dag := p.buildDAGFromRoot(root, recordByUuid)
   547→		if len(dag) > 0 {
   548→			dags = append(dags, dag)
   549→		}
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	return dags
   553→}
   554→
   555→// buildDAGFromRoot builds a DAG starting from a root node
   556→func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGFromRoot(root JSONLRecord, recordByUuid map[string]JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   557→	dag := []JSONLRecord{}
   558→	visited := make(map[string]bool)
   559→
   560→	var traverse func(node JSONLRecord)
   561→	traverse = func(node JSONLRecord) {
   562→		uuid, ok := node.Data["uuid"].(string)
   563→		if !ok || visited[uuid] {
   564→			return
   565→		}
   566→
   567→		visited[uuid] = true
   568→		dag = append(dag, node)
   569→
   570→		// Find all children and collect them first
   571→		children := []JSONLRecord{}
   572→		for _, record := range recordByUuid {
   573→			parentUuid, ok := record.Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   574→			if ok && parentUuid == uuid {
   575→				// Check if this child exists in our map (to handle orphans)
   576→				if _, exists := recordByUuid[record.Data["uuid"].(string)]; exists {
   577→					children = append(children, record)
   578→				}
   579→			}
   580→		}
   581→
   582→		// Sort children by timestamp for deterministic traversal order
   583→		sort.Slice(children, func(i, j int) bool {
   584→			tsI, _ := children[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   585→			tsJ, _ := children[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   586→			return tsI < tsJ
   587→		})
   588→
   589→		// Traverse children in sorted order
   590→		for _, child := range children {
   591→			traverse(child)
   592→		}
   593→	}
   594→
   595→	traverse(root)
   596→	return dag
   597→}
   598→
   599→// flattenDAG flattens a DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
   600→func (p *JSONLParser) flattenDAG(dag []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
   601→	// Sort by timestamp, with parent-child relationships as tiebreaker
   602→	sort.Slice(dag, func(i, j int) bool {
   603→		tsI, _ := dag[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   604→		tsJ, _ := dag[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
   605→		if tsI != tsJ {
   606→			return tsI < tsJ
   607→		}
   608→		// If timestamps are equal, check parent-child relationship
   609→		uuidI, _ := dag[i].Data["uuid"].(string)
   610→		uuidJ, _ := dag[j].Data["uuid"].(string)
   611→		parentI, _ := dag[i].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   612→		parentJ, _ := dag[j].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
   613→
   614→		// If j is the parent of i, j should come first
   615→		if parentI == uuidJ {
   616→			return false
   617→		}
   618→		// If i is the parent of j, i should come first
   619→		if parentJ == uuidI {
   620→			return true
   621→		}
   622→		// Otherwise, sort by UUID for deterministic ordering
   623→		return uuidI < uuidJ
   624→	})
   625→
   626→	return dag
   627→}
   628→
   629→// FindSession returns a pointer to the session with the given UUID
   630→func (p *JSONLParser) FindSession(sessionUuid string) *Session {
   631→	for i := range p.Sessions {
   632→		if p.Sessions[i].SessionUuid == sessionUuid {
   633→			return &p.Sessions[i]
   634→		}
   635→	}
   636→	return nil
   637→}
   638→
   639→// FindRecord returns a pointer to the first record that matches the given filter function
   640→func (p *JSONLParser) FindRecord(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) *JSONLRecord {
   641→	for i := range p.Records {
   642→		if filter(p.Records[i]) {
   643→			return &p.Records[i]
   644→		}
   645→	}
   646→	return nil
   647→}
   648→
   649→// FilterRecords returns records that match the given filter function
   650→func (p *JSONLParser) FilterRecords(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) []JSONLRecord {
   651→	var filtered []JSONLRecord
   652→	for _, record := range p.Records {
   653→		if filter(record) {
   654→			filtered = append(filtered, record)
   655→		}
   656→	}
   657→	return filtered
   658→}
   659→
   660→// Count returns the total number of parsed records
   661→func (p *JSONLParser) Count() int {
   662→	return len(p.Records)
   663→}

   110→// Check verifies OpenAI Codex CLI installation and returns version info.
   111→func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
   112→	codexCmd, _ := parseCodexCommand(customCommand)
   113→	isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
   114→
   115→	resolvedPath := codexCmd
   116→	if !filepath.IsAbs(codexCmd) {
   117→		if path, err := exec.LookPath(codexCmd); err == nil {
   118→			resolvedPath = path
   119→		}
   120→	}
   121→
   122→	versionOutput, versionFlag, stderrOutput, err := runCodexVersionCommand(codexCmd)
   123→	if err != nil {
   124→		errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
   125→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   126→			"provider":            "codex",
   127→			"custom_command":      isCustomCommand,
   128→			"command_path":        codexCmd,
   129→			"resolved_path":       resolvedPath,
   130→			"error_type":          errorType,
   131→			"version_flag":        versionFlag,
   132→			"stderr":              stderrOutput,
   133→			"error_message":       err.Error(),
   134→			"path_classification": classifyCodexPath(codexCmd, resolvedPath),
   135→		})
   136→
   137→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, codexCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
   138→
   139→		return spi.CheckResult{
   140→			Success:      false,
   141→			Version:      "",
   142→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   143→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   144→		}
   145→	}
   146→
   147→	if versionOutput == "" {
   148→		errorType := "no_output"
   149→		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
   150→			"provider":            "codex",
   151→			"custom_command":      isCustomCommand,
   152→			"command_path":        codexCmd,
   153→			"resolved_path":       resolvedPath,
   154→			"error_type":          errorType,

   159→
   160→		errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, codexCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
   161→
   162→		return spi.CheckResult{
   163→			Success:      false,
   164→			Version:      "",
   165→			Location:     resolvedPath,
   166→			ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
   167→		}
   168→	}
   169→
   170→	pathType := classifyCodexPath(codexCmd, resolvedPath)
   171→	analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
   172→		"provider":       "codex",
   173→		"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
   174→		"command_path":   resolvedPath,
   175→		"path_type":      pathType,
   176→		"version":        versionOutput,

   178→	})
   179→
   180→	slog.Debug("Codex CLI check successful", "version", versionOutput, "location", resolvedPath, "flag", versionFlag)
   181→
   182→	return spi.CheckResult{
   183→		Success:      true,
   184→		Version:      versionOutput,
   185→		Location:     resolvedPath,
   186→		ErrorMessage: "",
   187→	}

   190→// DetectAgent checks if OpenAI Codex CLI has been used in the given project path.
   191→func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
   192→	// Try to find sessions using the shared helper (stop on first match)
   193→	sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", true)
   194→
   195→	// Handle different error cases with helpful output
   196→	if err != nil {
   197→		// Check if it's a home directory error
   198→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
   199→			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Failed to resolve user home directory", "error", err)
   200→			if helpOutput {
   201→				fmt.Println()
   202→				log.UserWarn("Could not scan Codex CLI sessions for this directory.\n")
   203→				log.UserMessage("Reason: failed to determine your home directory.\n")
   204→				fmt.Println()
   205→			}
   206→			return false
   207→		}
   208→
   209→		// Check if it's a sessions directory error
   210→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") {
   211→			homeDir, _ := osUserHomeDir()
   212→			sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
   213→
   214→			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Codex sessions directory not accessible", "error", err)
   215→			if helpOutput {
   216→				fmt.Println()
   217→				log.UserWarn("No Codex CLI sessions were found for this directory.\n")
   218→				log.UserMessage("Codex CLI stores activity under ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/. We couldn't find that directory.\n\n")
   219→				log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
   220→				log.UserMessage("  1. Run `specstory run codex` to launch Codex CLI in this project\n")
   221→				log.UserMessage("  2. Or start Codex CLI manually, then run `specstory sync codex` afterward\n\n")
   222→				log.UserMessage("Expected sessions directory: %s\n", sessionsRoot)
   223→				fmt.Println()
   224→			}
   225→			return false
   226→		}
   227→
   228→		// Unknown error
   229→		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Error finding sessions", "error", err)
   230→		return false
   231→	}
   232→
   233→	// Check if we found any sessions
   234→	if len(sessions) > 0 {
   235→		session := sessions[0]
   236→		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Codex CLI activity detected",
   237→			"sessionID", session.SessionID,
   238→			"sessionPath", session.SessionPath)
   239→		return true
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	// No sessions found - provide helpful output
   243→	if helpOutput {
   244→		homeDir, _ := osUserHomeDir()
   245→		sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
   246→
   247→		fmt.Println()
   248→		log.UserWarn("No Codex CLI sessions were found for this directory.\n")
   249→		log.UserMessage("Codex CLI hasn't saved a session with this working directory yet.\n")
   250→		log.UserMessage("Codex stores sessions in ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/ as JSONL files.\n\n")
   251→		log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
   252→		log.UserMessage("  1. Run `specstory run codex` to launch Codex CLI here\n")
   253→		log.UserMessage("  2. Or open Codex CLI manually in this project, then try syncing again\n\n")
   254→		log.UserMessage("Checked sessions directory: %s\n", sessionsRoot)
   255→		fmt.Println()
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	return false
   259→}

   261→// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves chat sessions for the given project path.
   262→func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   263→	// Find all sessions for this project (don't stop on first)
   264→	sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", false)
   265→	if err != nil {
   266→		// If sessions directory doesn't exist, return empty list (not an error)
   267→		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") ||
   268→			strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") ||
   269→			strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
   270→			return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil
   271→		}
   272→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find codex sessions: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	// Convert to AgentChatSession structs
   276→	var result []spi.AgentChatSession
   277→	for _, sessionInfo := range sessions {
   278→		session, err := processSessionToAgentChat(&sessionInfo, projectPath, debugRaw)
   279→		if err != nil {
   280→			slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: Failed to process session",
   281→				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
   282→				"error", err)
   283→			continue // Skip sessions we can't process
   284→		}
   285→
   286→		// Skip empty sessions (processSessionToAgentChat returns nil for empty sessions)
   287→		if session == nil {
   288→			slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: Skipping empty session",
   289→				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
   290→			continue
   291→		}
   292→
   293→		result = append(result, *session)
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	return result, nil
   297→}

   316→	}
   317→
   318→	// Process the first (and only) session using shared helper
   319→	return processSessionToAgentChat(&sessions[0], projectPath, debugRaw)
   320→}

   322→// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Codex CLI in interactive mode and monitors for session updates.
   323→// The function blocks until the Codex CLI exits. During execution, it watches for JSONL file changes
   324→// and invokes sessionCallback for each update, enabling real-time markdown generation and cloud sync.
   325→func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   326→	slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Starting Codex CLI execution and monitoring",
   327→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   328→		"customCommand", customCommand,
   329→		"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
   330→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   331→
   332→	// Log if resuming a specific session
   333→	if resumeSessionID != "" {
   334→		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Will resume specific Codex session", "sessionID", resumeSessionID)
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	// Set up the callback which enables real-time markdown generation and cloud sync during
   338→	// interactive sessions. As Codex CLI writes JSONL updates, the watcher detects changes
   339→	// and invokes this callback, allowing immediate processing without blocking the agent's
   340→	// execution. The defer ensures cleanup when the agent exits.
   341→	SetWatcherCallback(sessionCallback)
   342→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   343→
   344→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   345→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   346→
   347→	// Start watching for Codex sessions in the background
   348→	slog.Info("Initializing Codex session monitoring...")
   349→
   350→	if err := WatchForCodexSessions(projectPath, resumeSessionID); err != nil {
   351→		// Log the error but don't fail - watcher might work later
   352→		slog.Error("Failed to start Codex session watcher", "error", err)
   353→	}
   354→
   355→	// Execute Codex CLI - this blocks until Codex exits
   356→	slog.Info("Executing Codex CLI", "command", customCommand, "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID)
   357→	err := ExecuteCodex(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
   358→
   359→	// Stop the watcher goroutine and wait for it to finish before returning
   360→	slog.Info("Codex CLI has exited, stopping watcher")
   361→	StopWatcher()
   362→
   363→	// Return any execution error
   364→	if err != nil {
   365→		return fmt.Errorf("codex CLI execution failed: %w", err)
   366→	}
   367→
   368→	return nil
   369→}

   371→// WatchAgent watches for Codex CLI agent activity and calls the callback with AgentChatSession
   372→// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for existing activity
   373→// Runs until error or context cancellation (blocks indefinitely)
   374→func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
   375→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Starting Codex CLI activity monitoring",
   376→		"projectPath", projectPath,
   377→		"debugRaw", debugRaw)
   378→
   379→	// The watcher callback directly passes AgentChatSession (which now contains SessionData)
   380→	wrappedCallback := func(agentChatSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
   381→		slog.Debug("WatchAgent: Received AgentChatSession",
   382→			"sessionID", agentChatSession.SessionID,
   383→			"hasSessionData", agentChatSession.SessionData != nil)
   384→
   385→		// Call the user's callback with the AgentChatSession
   386→		sessionCallback(agentChatSession)
   387→	}
   388→
   389→	// Set up the callback for the watcher
   390→	SetWatcherCallback(wrappedCallback)
   391→	defer ClearWatcherCallback()
   392→
   393→	// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
   394→	SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
   395→
   396→	// Start watching for Codex sessions in the background
   397→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Initializing Codex session monitoring...")
   398→
   399→	if err := WatchForCodexSessions(projectPath, ""); err != nil {
   400→		slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to start Codex session watcher", "error", err)
   401→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start watcher: %w", err)
   402→	}
   403→
   404→	// Block until context is cancelled
   405→	// The watcher runs in a background goroutine and will continue
   406→	// until context is cancelled or the process exits
   407→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Watcher started, blocking until context cancelled")
   408→
   409→	// Wait for context cancellation
   410→	<-ctx.Done()
   411→
   412→	slog.Info("WatchAgent: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
   413→	StopWatcher()
   414→
   415→	return ctx.Err()
   416→}
