```text
   418→// findCodexSessions traverses the Codex CLI sessions directory structure and finds
   419→// sessions that match the given project path.
   420→//
   421→// Short-circuit behavior:
   422→//   - If targetSessionID is provided: stops when that specific session is found (ignores stopOnFirst)
   423→//   - If targetSessionID is empty and stopOnFirst is true: stops after finding first matching session
   424→//   - If targetSessionID is empty and stopOnFirst is false: returns all matching sessions
   425→func findCodexSessions(projectPath string, targetSessionID string, stopOnFirst bool) ([]codexSessionInfo, error) {
   426→	normalizedProjectPath := normalizeCodexPath(projectPath)
   427→	if normalizedProjectPath == "" {
   428→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Unable to normalize project path", "projectPath", projectPath)
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	homeDir, err := osUserHomeDir()
   432→	if err != nil {
   433→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to resolve user home directory", "error", err)
   434→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to determine home directory: %w", err)
   435→	}
   436→
   437→	sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
   438→	rootInfo, err := os.Stat(sessionsRoot)
   439→	if err != nil {
   440→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   441→			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex sessions directory not found", "path", sessionsRoot)
   442→		} else {
   443→			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to stat Codex sessions directory", "path", sessionsRoot, "error", err)
   444→		}
   445→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions directory not accessible: %w", err)
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	if !rootInfo.IsDir() {
   449→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex sessions root is not a directory", "path", sessionsRoot)
   450→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions root is not a directory: %s", sessionsRoot)
   451→	}
   452→
   453→	yearEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(sessionsRoot)
   454→	if err != nil {
   455→		slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex sessions root", "path", sessionsRoot, "error", err)
   456→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read sessions root: %w", err)
   457→	}
   458→
   459→	var sessions []codexSessionInfo
   460→
   461→	// Traverse year/month/day directory structure
   462→	for _, yearEntry := range yearEntries {
   463→		if !yearEntry.IsDir() {
   464→			continue
   465→		}
   466→
   467→		yearPath := filepath.Join(sessionsRoot, yearEntry.Name())
   468→		monthEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(yearPath)
   469→		if err != nil {
   470→			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex year directory", "path", yearPath, "error", err)
   471→			continue
   472→		}
   473→
   474→		for _, monthEntry := range monthEntries {
   475→			if !monthEntry.IsDir() {
   476→				continue
   477→			}
   478→
   479→			monthPath := filepath.Join(yearPath, monthEntry.Name())
   480→			dayEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(monthPath)
   481→			if err != nil {
   482→				slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex month directory", "path", monthPath, "error", err)
   483→				continue
   484→			}
   485→
   486→			for _, dayEntry := range dayEntries {
   487→				if !dayEntry.IsDir() {
   488→					continue
   489→				}
   490→
   491→				dayPath := filepath.Join(monthPath, dayEntry.Name())
   492→				sessionEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(dayPath)
   493→				if err != nil {
   494→					slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex day directory", "path", dayPath, "error", err)
   495→					continue
   496→				}
   497→
   498→				for _, sessionEntry := range sessionEntries {
   499→					if sessionEntry.IsDir() {
   500→						continue
   501→					}
   502→					if filepath.Ext(sessionEntry.Name()) != ".jsonl" {
   503→						continue
   504→					}
   505→
   506→					sessionPath := filepath.Join(dayPath, sessionEntry.Name())
   507→					meta, err := loadCodexSessionMeta(sessionPath)
   508→					if err != nil {
   509→						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to load Codex session meta", "path", sessionPath, "error", err)
   510→						continue
   511→					}
   512→
   513→					sessionID := strings.TrimSpace(meta.Payload.ID)
   514→					normalizedCWD := normalizeCodexPath(meta.Payload.CWD)
   515→					if normalizedCWD == "" {
   516→						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Session meta missing cwd", "sessionID", sessionID, "path", sessionPath)
   517→						continue
   518→					}
   519→
   520→					// Check if this session matches the project path
   521→					matched := false
   522→					if normalizedProjectPath != "" {
   523→						if normalizedCWD == normalizedProjectPath || strings.EqualFold(normalizedCWD, normalizedProjectPath) {
   524→							matched = true
   525→						}
   526→					} else if normalizedCWD == projectPath || strings.EqualFold(normalizedCWD, projectPath) {
   527→						matched = true
   528→					}
   529→
   530→					if matched {
   531→						// If we're searching for a specific session, skip sessions that don't match
   532→						if targetSessionID != "" && sessionID != targetSessionID {
   533→							continue
   534→						}
   535→
   536→						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex CLI session matched project",
   537→							"sessionID", sessionID,
   538→							"sessionPath", sessionPath)
   539→
   540→						sessions = append(sessions, codexSessionInfo{
   541→							SessionID:   sessionID,
   542→							SessionPath: sessionPath,
   543→							Meta:        meta,
   544→						})
   545→
   546→						// Short-circuit logic:
   547→						// 1. If we have a target sessionID and this matches, we're done
   548→						if targetSessionID != "" && sessionID == targetSessionID {
   549→							slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Found target session, stopping search", "sessionID", targetSessionID)
   550→							return sessions, nil
   551→						}
   552→
   553→						// 2. If stopOnFirst is true (and no target sessionID), return first match
   554→						if targetSessionID == "" && stopOnFirst {
   555→							return sessions, nil
   556→						}
   557→
   558→						// 3. Otherwise, continue collecting all matching sessions
   559→					}
   560→				}
   561→			}
   562→		}
   563→	}
   564→
   565→	return sessions, nil
   566→}

   568→// readSessionRawData reads all JSONL lines from a Codex CLI session file and returns
   569→// both the parsed records and the raw JSONL content.
   570→func readSessionRawData(sessionPath string) ([]map[string]interface{}, string, error) {
   571→	file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
   572→	if err != nil {
   573→		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
   574→	}
   575→	defer func() {
   576→		_ = file.Close()
   577→	}()
   578→
   579→	var records []map[string]interface{}
   580→	var rawBuilder strings.Builder
   581→
   582→	// Use bufio.Reader instead of Scanner to handle arbitrarily large lines
   583→	// Scanner has a token size limit (even with custom buffer), but Reader does not
   584→	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
   585→
   586→	lineNumber := 0
   587→	for {
   588→		// Read line using ReadString which has no size limit
   589→		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   590→		line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
   591→
   592→		// EOF is expected at end of file, other errors are genuine failures
   593→		if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
   594→			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("error reading line %d: %w", lineNumber+1, err)
   595→		}
   596→
   597→		// Determine if we're at end of file and if we have content to process
   598→		atEOF := err == io.EOF
   599→		hasContent := len(line) > 0
   600→
   601→		// Increment line number for every line read (including empty lines) to match text editor line numbers
   602→		if hasContent || !atEOF {
   603→			lineNumber++
   604→		}
   605→
   606→		// If no content, either skip empty line or exit at EOF
   607→		if !hasContent {
   608→			if atEOF {
   609→				break // Reached end of file with no content
   610→			}
   611→			continue // Empty line in middle of file, skip it
   612→		}
   613→
   614→		// Sanity check to prevent OOM from pathological files
   615→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   616→			slog.Warn("line exceeds reasonable size limit",
   617→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   618→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   619→				"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB,
   620→				"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath))
   621→			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB): refusing to process potentially malformed file",
   622→				lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
   623→		}
   624→
   625→		// Log when processing unusually large lines (helps debug performance issues)
   626→		if len(line) > 10*MB {
   627→			slog.Debug("processing large JSONL line",
   628→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   629→				"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
   630→				"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath))
   631→		}
   632→
   633→		// Trim whitespace and skip empty lines
   634→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   635→		if line == "" {
   636→			if atEOF {
   637→				break
   638→			}
   639→			continue
   640→		}
   641→
   642→		// Add to raw data
   643→		rawBuilder.WriteString(line)
   644→		rawBuilder.WriteString("\n")
   645→
   646→		// Parse JSON
   647→		var record map[string]interface{}
   648→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); err != nil {
   649→			slog.Debug("readSessionRawData: Failed to parse JSON line",
   650→				"error", err,
   651→				"lineNumber", lineNumber,
   652→				"line", line[:min(len(line), 100)])
   653→			// After processing record, check if we're done
   654→			if atEOF {
   655→				break
   656→			}
   657→			continue
   658→		}
   659→
   660→		records = append(records, record)
   661→
   662→		// After processing record, check if we're done
   663→		if atEOF {
   664→			break
   665→		}
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	return records, rawBuilder.String(), nil
   669→}
   670→
   671→// loadCodexSessionMeta reads the first JSON line from a session file and parses the session metadata.
   672→func loadCodexSessionMeta(sessionPath string) (*codexSessionMeta, error) {
   673→	file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
   674→	if err != nil {
   675→		return nil, err
   676→	}
   677→	defer func() {
   678→		_ = file.Close()
   679→	}()
   680→
   681→	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
   682→	if !scanner.Scan() {
   683→		if scanErr := scanner.Err(); scanErr != nil {
   684→			return nil, scanErr
   685→		}
   686→		return nil, errors.New("codex session meta not found")
   687→	}
   688→
   689→	line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
   690→	if line == "" {
   691→		return nil, errors.New("codex session meta is empty")
   692→	}
   693→
   694→	var meta codexSessionMeta
   695→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &meta); err != nil {
   696→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse codex session meta: %w", err)
   697→	}
   698→
   699→	if meta.Type != "session_meta" {
   700→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected codex session record type: %s", meta.Type)
   701→	}
   702→
   703→	return &meta, nil
   704→}
   705→
   706→// processSessionToAgentChat converts a codexSessionInfo into an AgentChatSession by reading
   707→// the session data, generating SessionData, and optionally writing debug files. Returns nil if
   708→// the session is empty or cannot be read.
   709→func processSessionToAgentChat(sessionInfo *codexSessionInfo, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
   710→	// Read the session data
   711→	records, rawData, err := readSessionRawData(sessionInfo.SessionPath)
   712→	if err != nil {
   713→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session data: %w", err)
   714→	}
   715→
   716→	// Skip empty sessions
   717→	if len(records) == 0 {
   718→		return nil, nil
   719→	}
   720→
   721→	// Get timestamp from metadata
   722→	timestamp := sessionInfo.Meta.Timestamp
   723→
   724→	// Generate slug from first user message
   725→	firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(records)
   726→	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
   727→	if slug == "" {
   728→		slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: No user message for slug yet",
   729→			"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
   730→	} else {
   731→		slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Generated slug from user message",
   732→			"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
   733→			"slug", slug)
   734→	}
   735→
   736→	// Generate SessionData from records
   737→	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(records, workspaceRoot)
   738→	if err != nil {
   739→		slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", sessionInfo.SessionID, "error", err)
   740→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate SessionData: %w", err)
   741→	}
   742→
   743→	// Write provider-specific debug files if requested
   744→	if debugRaw {
   745→		if err := writeDebugRawFiles(sessionInfo.SessionID, records); err != nil {
   746→			slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Failed to write debug files",
   747→				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
   748→				"error", err)
   749→			// Don't fail the operation if debug output fails
   750→		}
   751→	}
   752→
   753→	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
   754→		SessionID:   sessionInfo.SessionID,
   755→		CreatedAt:   timestamp,
   756→		Slug:        slug,
   757→		SessionData: sessionData,
   758→		RawData:     rawData,
   759→	}, nil
   760→}
   761→
   762→// writeDebugRawFiles writes debug JSON files for a Codex CLI session.
   763→// Each record is written as a numbered JSON file in .specstory/debug/<session-id>/
   764→func writeDebugRawFiles(sessionID string, records []map[string]interface{}) error {
   765→	// Get the debug directory path
   766→	debugDir := spi.GetDebugDir(sessionID)
   767→
   768→	// Create the debug directory
   769→	if err := os.MkdirAll(debugDir, 0755); err != nil {
   770→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create debug directory: %w", err)
   771→	}
   772→
   773→	// Write each record as a pretty-printed JSON file
   774→	for index, record := range records {
   775→		// Create filename with 1-based index for readability
   776→		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", index+1)
   777→		debugPath := filepath.Join(debugDir, filename)
   778→
   779→		// Pretty print the record
   780→		prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(record, "", "  ")
   781→		if err != nil {
   782→			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to marshal record to JSON",
   783→				"index", index,
   784→				"error", err)
   785→			continue
   786→		}
   787→
   788→		// Write the file
   789→		if err := os.WriteFile(debugPath, prettyJSON, 0644); err != nil {
   790→			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to write debug file",
   791→				"path", debugPath,
   792→				"error", err)
   793→			continue
   794→		}
   795→
   796→		slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Wrote debug file",
   797→			"path", debugPath,
   798→			"index", index)
   799→	}
   800→
   801→	return nil
   802→}
   803→
   804→// findFirstUserMessage extracts the first user message from Codex CLI session records.
   805→// Returns empty string if no user message is found.
   806→func findFirstUserMessage(records []map[string]interface{}) string {
   807→	for _, record := range records {
   808→		// Get record type
   809→		recordType, ok := record["type"].(string)
   810→		if !ok || recordType != "event_msg" {
   811→			continue
   812→		}
   813→
   814→		// Get payload
   815→		payload, ok := record["payload"].(map[string]interface{})
   816→		if !ok {
   817→			continue
   818→		}
   819→
   820→		// Check if this is a user message
   821→		payloadType, ok := payload["type"].(string)
   822→		if !ok || payloadType != "user_message" {
   823→			continue
   824→		}
   825→
   826→		// Extract the message content
   827→		message, ok := payload["message"].(string)
   828→		if !ok || message == "" {
   829→			continue
   830→		}
   831→
   832→		// Found the first user message
   833→		slog.Debug("findFirstUserMessage: Found first user message",
   834→			"message", message[:min(len(message), 100)])
   835→		return message
   836→	}
   837→
   838→	slog.Debug("findFirstUserMessage: No user message found in session")
   839→	return ""
   840→}
```

```text
    80→// parseFactorySession converts a Factory Droid JSONL transcript into an fdSession.
    81→func parseFactorySession(filePath string) (*fdSession, error) {
    82→	file, err := os.Open(filePath)
    83→	if err != nil {
    84→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("droidcli: unable to open session %s: %w", filePath, err)
    85→	}
    86→	defer func() {
    87→		_ = file.Close()
    88→	}()
    89→
    90→	session := &fdSession{Blocks: make([]fdBlock, 0, 64)}
    91→	toolIndex := make(map[string]*fdToolCall)
    92→	var rawBuilder strings.Builder
    93→	var firstUserText string
    94→	var firstTimestamp string
    95→
    96→	scanErr := scanLines(file, func(line string) error {
    97→		rawBuilder.WriteString(line)
    98→		rawBuilder.WriteByte('\n')
    99→
   100→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   101→		if trimmed == "" {
   102→			return nil
   103→		}
   104→
   105→		var env jsonlEnvelope
   106→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &env); err != nil {
   107→			slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed JSONL line", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   108→			return nil
   109→		}
   110→
   111→		switch env.Type {
   112→		case "session_start":
   113→			var event sessionStartEvent
   114→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   115→				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed session_start event", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   116→				return nil
   117→			}
   118→			session.ID = fallback(session.ID, firstNonEmpty(event.ID, event.Session.ID))
   119→			session.Title = fallback(session.Title, firstNonEmpty(event.Title, event.Session.Title, event.SessionTitle))
   120→			session.CreatedAt = fallback(session.CreatedAt, firstNonEmpty(event.CreatedAt, event.Session.CreatedAt, event.Timestamp))
   121→			session.WorkspaceRoot = fallback(session.WorkspaceRoot, firstNonEmpty(event.CWD, event.WorkspaceRoot, event.Session.CWD, event.Session.WorkspaceRoot))
   122→		case "message":
   123→			var event messageEvent
   124→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   125→				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed message event", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   126→				return nil
   127→			}
   128→			if firstTimestamp == "" {
   129→				firstTimestamp = normalizeEventTimestamp(event.Timestamp)
   130→			}
   131→			handleMessageEvent(session, &event, toolIndex)
   132→			if strings.EqualFold(event.Message.Role, "user") {
   133→				if firstUserText == "" {
   134→					firstUserText = firstUserContent(event.Message.Content)
   135→				}
   136→			}
   137→		case "todo_state":
   138→			var event todoEvent
   139→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   140→				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed todo_state event", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   141→				return nil
   142→			}
   143→			if firstTimestamp == "" {
   144→				firstTimestamp = normalizeEventTimestamp(event.Timestamp)
   145→			}
   146→			if len(event.Todos) == 0 {
   147→				return nil
   148→			}
   149→			session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   150→				Kind:      blockTodo,
   151→				Role:      "agent",
   152→				Timestamp: event.Timestamp,
   153→				Todo: &fdTodoState{
   154→					Items: append([]fdTodoItem(nil), event.Todos...),
   155→				},
   156→			})
   157→		case "compaction_state":
   158→			var event compactionEvent
   159→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &event); err != nil {
   160→				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping malformed compaction_state event", "error", err, "file", filePath)
   161→				return nil
   162→			}
   163→			if firstTimestamp == "" {
   164→				firstTimestamp = normalizeEventTimestamp(event.Timestamp)
   165→			}
   166→			if strings.TrimSpace(event.Summary.Body) == "" {
   167→				return nil
   168→			}
   169→			session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   170→				Kind:      blockSummary,
   171→				Role:      "agent",
   172→				Timestamp: event.Timestamp,
   173→				Summary:   &event.Summary,
   174→			})
   175→		}
   176→
   177→		return nil
   178→	})
   179→	if scanErr != nil {
   180→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("droidcli: failed scanning %s: %w", filePath, scanErr)
   181→	}
   182→
   183→	if session.ID == "" {
   184→		session.ID = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(filePath), filepath.Ext(filePath))
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	if session.CreatedAt == "" {
   188→		session.CreatedAt = fallback(firstTimestamp, deriveTimestampFromFilename(filePath))
   189→	}
   190→
   191→	session.Slug = slugFromContent(firstUserText, session.Title, session.CreatedAt)
   192→	session.RawData = rawBuilder.String()
   193→
   194→	return session, nil
   195→}
   196→
   197→func handleMessageEvent(session *fdSession, event *messageEvent, toolIndex map[string]*fdToolCall) {
   198→	role := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Message.Role))
   199→	if role == "" {
   200→		role = "agent"
   201→	}
   202→	model := strings.TrimSpace(event.Message.Model)
   203→
   204→	for _, block := range event.Message.Content {
   205→		switch block.Type {
   206→		case "text":
   207→			appendTextBlock(session, role, model, event.Timestamp, block.Text, false, event.ID)
   208→		case "reasoning", "thinking", "thought":
   209→			// Thinking content may be in the "thinking" field or "text" field depending on the format
   210→			thinkingText := block.Thinking
   211→			if thinkingText == "" {
   212→				thinkingText = block.Text
   213→			}
   214→			appendTextBlock(session, role, model, event.Timestamp, thinkingText, true, event.ID)
   215→		case "tool_use":
   216→			tool := &fdToolCall{
   217→				ID:         block.ID,
   218→				Name:       block.Name,
   219→				Input:      block.Input,
   220→				RiskLevel:  block.RiskLevel,
   221→				RiskReason: block.RiskLevelReason,
   222→				InvokedAt:  event.Timestamp,
   223→			}
   224→			session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   225→				Kind:      blockTool,
   226→				Role:      role,
   227→				MessageID: strings.TrimSpace(event.ID),
   228→				Timestamp: event.Timestamp,
   229→				Model:     model,
   230→				Tool:      tool,
   231→			})
   232→			if tool.ID != "" {
   233→				toolIndex[tool.ID] = tool
   234→			}
   235→		case "tool_result":
   236→			result := &fdToolResult{
   237→				Content: decodeContent(block.Content),
   238→				IsError: block.IsError,
   239→			}
   240→			if ref := toolIndex[block.ToolUseID]; ref != nil {
   241→				ref.Result = result
   242→			} else {
   243→				session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   244→					Kind:      blockTool,
   245→					Role:      role,
   246→					MessageID: strings.TrimSpace(event.ID),
   247→					Timestamp: event.Timestamp,
   248→					Model:     model,
   249→					Tool: &fdToolCall{
   250→						ID:        block.ToolUseID,
   251→						Name:      "tool_result",
   252→						Result:    result,
   253→						InvokedAt: event.Timestamp,
   254→					},
   255→				})
   256→			}
   257→		}
   258→	}
   259→}
   260→
   261→func appendTextBlock(session *fdSession, role, model, timestamp, rawText string, reasoning bool, messageID string) {
   262→	text := strings.TrimSpace(rawText)
   263→	if text == "" {
   264→		return
   265→	}
   266→	session.Blocks = append(session.Blocks, fdBlock{
   267→		Kind:        blockText,
   268→		Role:        role,
   269→		MessageID:   strings.TrimSpace(messageID),
   270→		Timestamp:   timestamp,
   271→		Model:       model,
   272→		Text:        text,
   273→		IsReasoning: reasoning,
   274→	})
   275→}
   276→
   277→func firstUserContent(blocks []contentPayload) string {
   278→	for _, block := range blocks {
   279→		if block.Type != "text" {
   280→			continue
   281→		}
   282→		text := strings.TrimSpace(block.Text)
   283→		text = cleanUserText(text)
   284→		if text != "" {
   285→			return text
   286→		}
   287→	}
   288→	return ""
   289→}
   290→
   291→func decodeContent(raw json.RawMessage) string {
   292→	if len(raw) == 0 || string(raw) == "null" {
   293→		return ""
   294→	}
   295→	var str string
   296→	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &str); err == nil {
   297→		return str
   298→	}
   299→	var arr []map[string]any
   300→	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &arr); err == nil {
   301→		var builder strings.Builder
   302→		for _, item := range arr {
   303→			if text, ok := item["text"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(text) != "" {
   304→				if builder.Len() > 0 {
   305→					builder.WriteString("\n")
   306→				}
   307→				builder.WriteString(text)
   308→			}
   309→		}
   310→		return builder.String()
   311→	}
   312→	var obj map[string]any
   313→	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &obj); err == nil {
   314→		if text, ok := obj["text"].(string); ok {
   315→			return text
   316→		}
   317→		bytes, err := json.Marshal(obj)
   318→		if err == nil {
   319→			return string(bytes)
   320→		}
   321→	}
   322→	return string(raw)
   323→}
   324→
   325→func slugFromContent(text string, title string, created string) string {
   326→	if slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(text); slug != "" {
   327→		return slug
   328→	}
   329→	if slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(title); slug != "" {
   330→		return slug
   331→	}
   332→	if created != "" {
   333→		return strings.ToLower(strings.ReplaceAll(created, ":", "-"))
   334→	}
   335→	return "factory-session"
   336→}
   337→
   338→func deriveTimestampFromFilename(path string) string {
   339→	base := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), filepath.Ext(path))
   340→	return base
   341→}
   342→
   343→func fallback(current, candidate string) string {
   344→	if strings.TrimSpace(current) != "" {
   345→		return current
   346→	}
   347→	return strings.TrimSpace(candidate)
   348→}
   349→
   350→func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
   351→	for _, value := range values {
   352→		if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
   353→			return strings.TrimSpace(value)
   354→		}
   355→	}
   356→	return ""
   357→}
   358→
   359→func normalizeEventTimestamp(ts string) string {
   360→	return strings.TrimSpace(ts)
   361→}
   362→
   363→// Scanner utilities for reading JSONL files
   364→
   365→const (
   366→	kb                    = 1024
   367→	mb                    = 1024 * kb
   368→	maxReasonableLineSize = 250 * mb
   369→)
   370→
   371→var errStopScan = errors.New("stop scan")
   372→
   373→func scanLines(reader io.Reader, handle func(line string) error) error {
   374→	buf := bufio.NewReader(reader)
   375→	lineNumber := 0
   376→
   377→	for {
   378→		line, err := buf.ReadString('\n')
   379→		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   380→			return err
   381→		}
   382→
   383→		if err == io.EOF && line == "" {
   384→			break
   385→		}
   386→
   387→		lineNumber++
   388→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   389→			return fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB)", lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/mb)
   390→		}
   391→
   392→		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\n")
   393→		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r")
   394→		if line == "" {
   395→			if err == io.EOF {
   396→				break
   397→			}
   398→			continue
   399→		}
   400→
   401→		if handleErr := handle(line); handleErr != nil {
   402→			return handleErr
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		if err == io.EOF {
   406→			break
   407→		}
   408→	}
   409→
   410→	return nil
   411→}
   412→
   413→// Text cleaning utilities
   414→
   415→var systemReminderPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)`)
   416→
   417→func cleanUserText(text string) string {
   418→	clean := systemReminderPattern.ReplaceAllString(text, "")
   419→	return strings.TrimSpace(clean)
   420→}
   421→
```

```text
   529→	flattened := parser.flattenDAG(dag)
   530→
   531→	if len(flattened) != 3 {
   532→		t.Errorf("Expected 3 records after flattening, got %d", len(flattened))
   533→	}
   534→
   535→	// Check order - should be sorted by timestamp
   536→	expectedOrder := []string{"a", "b", "c"}
   537→	for i, expected := range expectedOrder {
   538→		if flattened[i].Data["uuid"] != expected {
   539→			t.Errorf("Expected record %d to be %s, got %v", i, expected, flattened[i].Data["uuid"])
   540→		}
   541→	}
   542→}

   544→// TestEliminateDuplicates tests that duplicate records are properly eliminated
   545→func TestEliminateDuplicates(t *testing.T) {
   546→	parser := NewJSONLParser()
   547→
   548→	records := []JSONLRecord{
   549→		{
   550→			Data: map[string]interface{}{
   551→				"uuid":      "duplicate",
   552→				"timestamp": "2024-01-01T12:00:01Z", // Later timestamp
   553→				"content":   "version 2",
   554→			},
   555→		},
   556→		{
   557→			Data: map[string]interface{}{
   558→				"uuid":      "duplicate",
   559→				"timestamp": "2024-01-01T12:00:00Z", // Earlier timestamp - should be kept
   560→				"content":   "version 1",
   561→			},
   562→		},
   563→		{
   564→			Data: map[string]interface{}{
   565→				"uuid":      "unique",
   566→				"timestamp": "2024-01-01T12:00:00Z",
   567→				"content":   "unique record",
   568→			},
   569→		},
   570→		{
   571→			Data: map[string]interface{}{
   572→				// Record without UUID should be skipped
   573→				"timestamp": "2024-01-01T12:00:00Z",
   574→				"content":   "no uuid",
   575→			},
   576→		},
   577→	}
   578→
   579→	deduped := parser.eliminateDuplicates(records)
   580→
   581→	// Should have 2 records (duplicate merged, no-uuid skipped)
   582→	if len(deduped) != 2 {
   583→		t.Errorf("Expected 2 records after deduplication, got %d", len(deduped))
   584→	}
   585→
   586→	// Find the duplicate record
   587→	var duplicateRecord *JSONLRecord
   588→	for i := range deduped {
   589→		if deduped[i].Data["uuid"] == "duplicate" {
   590→			duplicateRecord = &deduped[i]
   591→			break
   592→		}
   593→	}
   594→
   595→	if duplicateRecord == nil {
   596→		t.Errorf("Duplicate record not found after deduplication")
   597→	} else {
   598→		// Should have kept the earlier timestamp version
   599→		if duplicateRecord.Data["content"] != "version 1" {
   600→			t.Errorf("Expected to keep version 1 (earlier timestamp), got %v", duplicateRecord.Data["content"])
   601→		}
   602→	}
   603→}

   806→	for _, tt := range tests {

   815→
   816→			if tt.validate != nil {

   818→			}
   819→		})
   820→	}
   821→}

   823→// TestBuildDAGs_LargeDataset tests DAG building performance with 10,000 records
   824→// This ensures the algorithm handles large datasets without stack overflow
   825→func TestBuildDAGs_LargeDataset(t *testing.T) {
   826→	tests := []struct {
   827→		name         string
   828→		recordCount  int
   829→		description  string
   830→		sessionCount int
   831→		validate     func(t *testing.T, dags [][]JSONLRecord, recordCount int)
   832→	}{
   833→		{
   834→			name:         "Single session with 10000 records",
   835→			recordCount:  10000,
   836→			sessionCount: 1,
   837→			description:  "Should handle deep chain without stack overflow",
   838→			validate: func(t *testing.T, dags [][]JSONLRecord, recordCount int) {
   839→				if len(dags) != 1 {
   840→					t.Errorf("Expected 1 DAG, got %d", len(dags))
   841→					return
   842→				}
   843→				if len(dags[0]) != recordCount {
   844→					t.Errorf("Expected DAG with %d records, got %d", recordCount, len(dags[0]))
   845→				}
   846→			},
   847→		},
   848→		{
   849→			name:         "Multiple sessions totaling 10000 records",
   850→			recordCount:  10000,
   851→			sessionCount: 100, // 100 sessions with 100 records each
   852→			description:  "Should handle many separate DAGs efficiently",
   853→			validate: func(t *testing.T, dags [][]JSONLRecord, recordCount int) {
   854→				if len(dags) != 100 {
   855→					t.Errorf("Expected 100 DAGs, got %d", len(dags))
   856→					return
   857→				}
   858→				totalRecords := 0
   859→				for _, dag := range dags {
   860→					totalRecords += len(dag)
   861→				}
   862→				if totalRecords != recordCount {
   863→					t.Errorf("Expected %d total records across DAGs, got %d", recordCount, totalRecords)
   864→				}
   865→			},
   866→		},
   867→	}
   868→
   869→	for _, tt := range tests {
   870→		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   871→			var records []JSONLRecord
   872→
   873→			if tt.sessionCount == 1 {
   874→				// Generate a single deep chain
   875→				records = generateDeepChain(tt.recordCount, "session-1")
   876→			} else {
   877→				// Generate multiple sessions
   878→				records = generateMultipleSessions(tt.recordCount, tt.sessionCount)
   879→			}
   880→
   881→			// Time the DAG building to ensure reasonable performance
   882→			startTime := time.Now()
   883→			parser := NewJSONLParser()
   884→			dags := parser.buildDAGs(records)
   885→			elapsed := time.Since(startTime)
   886→
   887→			// Performance check - should complete within reasonable time
   888→			maxDuration := 20 * time.Second
   889→			if elapsed > maxDuration {
   890→				t.Errorf("%s: DAG building took %v, exceeding max duration of %v",
   891→					tt.description, elapsed, maxDuration)
   892→			}
   893→
   894→			t.Logf("%s: Built %d DAGs from %d records in %v",
   895→				tt.name, len(dags), tt.recordCount, elapsed)
   896→
   897→			if tt.validate != nil {
   898→				tt.validate(t, dags, tt.recordCount)
   899→			}
   900→
   901→			// Verify no corruption in the DAG structure
   902→			for i, dag := range dags {
   903→				if !verifyDAGIntegrity(dag) {
   904→					t.Errorf("DAG %d has integrity issues", i)
   905→				}
   906→			}
   907→		})
   908→	}
   909→}

   911→// generateDeepChain creates a linear chain of records for testing
   912→func generateDeepChain(count int, sessionId string) []JSONLRecord {
   913→	records := make([]JSONLRecord, count)
   914→
   915→	// Create root record
   916→	records[0] = JSONLRecord{
   917→		Data: map[string]interface{}{
   918→			"type":       "user",
   919→			"uuid":       fmt.Sprintf("record-%d", 0),
   920→			"sessionId":  sessionId,
   921→			"timestamp":  fmt.Sprintf("2024-01-01T12:00:%02d.%03dZ", 0, 0),
   922→			"parentUuid": nil,
   923→			"message": map[string]interface{}{
   924→				"role":    "user",
   925→				"content": "Start of conversation",
   926→			},
   927→		},
   928→	}
   929→
   930→	// Create chain of records
   931→	for i := 1; i < count; i++ {
   932→		recordType := "user"
   933→		if i%2 == 0 {
   934→			recordType = "assistant"
   935→		}
   936→
   937→		// Format timestamp with proper seconds and milliseconds
   938→		seconds := (i / 1000) % 60
   939→		millis := i % 1000
   940→		minutes := (i / 60000) % 60
   941→		hours := 12 + (i / 3600000)
   942→
   943→		records[i] = JSONLRecord{
   944→			Data: map[string]interface{}{
   945→				"type":       recordType,
   946→				"uuid":       fmt.Sprintf("record-%d", i),
   947→				"sessionId":  sessionId,
   948→				"timestamp":  fmt.Sprintf("2024-01-01T%02d:%02d:%02d.%03dZ", hours, minutes, seconds, millis),
   949→				"parentUuid": fmt.Sprintf("record-%d", i-1),
   950→				"message": map[string]interface{}{
   951→					"role":    recordType,
   952→					"content": fmt.Sprintf("Message %d", i),
   953→				},
   954→			},
   955→		}
   956→	}
   957→
   958→	return records
   959→}
   960→
   961→// generateMultipleSessions creates multiple sessions with records
   962→func generateMultipleSessions(totalRecords int, sessionCount int) []JSONLRecord {
   963→	records := make([]JSONLRecord, 0, totalRecords)
   964→	recordsPerSession := totalRecords / sessionCount
   965→
   966→	for session := 0; session < sessionCount; session++ {
   967→		sessionId := fmt.Sprintf("session-%d", session)
   968→
   969→		// Create root for this session
   970→		records = append(records, JSONLRecord{
   971→			Data: map[string]interface{}{
   972→				"type":       "user",
   973→				"uuid":       fmt.Sprintf("s%d-record-0", session),
   974→				"sessionId":  sessionId,
   975→				"timestamp":  fmt.Sprintf("2024-01-01T%02d:00:00.000Z", session%24),
   976→				"parentUuid": nil,
   977→				"message": map[string]interface{}{
   978→					"role":    "user",
   979→					"content": fmt.Sprintf("Start of session %d", session),
   980→				},
   981→			},
   982→		})
   983→
   984→		// Add remaining records for this session
   985→		for i := 1; i < recordsPerSession && len(records) < totalRecords; i++ {
   986→			recordType := "user"
   987→			if i%2 == 0 {
   988→				recordType = "assistant"
   989→			}
   990→
   991→			records = append(records, JSONLRecord{
   992→				Data: map[string]interface{}{
   993→					"type":       recordType,
   994→					"uuid":       fmt.Sprintf("s%d-record-%d", session, i),
   995→					"sessionId":  sessionId,
   996→					"timestamp":  fmt.Sprintf("2024-01-01T%02d:00:%02d.%03dZ", session%24, i%60, i%1000),
   997→					"parentUuid": fmt.Sprintf("s%d-record-%d", session, i-1),
   998→					"message": map[string]interface{}{
   999→						"role":    recordType,
  1000→						"content": fmt.Sprintf("Session %d, Message %d", session, i),
  1001→					},
  1002→				},
  1003→			})
  1004→		}
  1005→	}
  1006→
  1007→	return records
  1008→}
  1009→
  1010→// verifyDAGIntegrity checks that a DAG maintains proper parent-child relationships
  1011→func verifyDAGIntegrity(dag []JSONLRecord) bool {
  1012→	if len(dag) == 0 {
  1013→		return true
  1014→	}
  1015→
  1016→	// Build a map of UUIDs for quick lookup
  1017→	uuidMap := make(map[string]bool)
  1018→	for _, record := range dag {
  1019→		if uuid, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string); ok {
  1020→			uuidMap[uuid] = true
  1021→		}
  1022→	}
  1023→
  1024→	// Verify each record's parent exists in the DAG (except root)
  1025→	for _, record := range dag {
  1026→		parentUuid := record.Data["parentUuid"]
  1027→		if parentUuid == nil {
  1028→			continue // Root record
  1029→		}
  1030→
  1031→		if parentStr, ok := parentUuid.(string); ok {
  1032→			if !uuidMap[parentStr] {
  1033→				return false // Parent doesn't exist in DAG
  1034→			}
  1035→		}
  1036→	}
  1037→
  1038→	return true
  1039→}
  1040→
  1041→// TestParseLargeJSONLLines tests that the parser can handle JSONL lines of various sizes
  1042→// Regression test for https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/issues/108
  1043→func TestParseLargeJSONLLines(t *testing.T) {
  1044→	tests := []struct {
  1045→		name        string
  1046→		lineSizeKB  int
  1047→		shouldPass  bool
  1048→		description string
  1049→		omitNewline bool
  1050→	}{
  1051→		{
  1052→			name:        "10KB line",
  1053→			lineSizeKB:  10,
  1054→			shouldPass:  true,
  1055→			description: "Should handle 10KB lines easily",
  1056→		},
  1057→		{
  1058→			name:        "100KB line",
  1059→			lineSizeKB:  100,
  1060→			shouldPass:  true,
  1061→			description: "Should handle 100KB lines",
  1062→		},
  1063→		{
  1064→			name:        "1MB line",
  1065→			lineSizeKB:  1024,
  1066→			shouldPass:  true,
  1067→			description: "Should handle 1MB lines",
  1068→		},
  1069→		{
  1070→			name:        "10MB line",
  1071→			lineSizeKB:  10240,
  1072→			shouldPass:  true,
  1073→			description: "Should handle 10MB lines (current buffer limit)",
  1074→		},
  1075→		{
  1076→			name:        "50MB line",
  1077→			lineSizeKB:  51200,
  1078→			shouldPass:  true, // Should handle arbitrarily large lines
  1079→			description: "Very large 50MB line - should handle without limits",
  1080→		},
  1081→		{
  1082→			name:        "line without trailing newline",
  1083→			lineSizeKB:  10,
  1084→			shouldPass:  true,
  1085→			description: "Should handle final line without newline at EOF",
  1086→			omitNewline: true,
  1087→		},
  1088→	}
  1089→
```

```text
   377→func scanLines(reader io.Reader, handle func(line string) error) error {
   378→	buf := bufio.NewReader(reader)
   379→	lineNumber := 0
   380→
   381→	for {
   382→		line, err := buf.ReadString('\n')
   383→		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   384→			return err
   385→		}
   386→
   387→		if err == io.EOF && line == "" {
   388→			break
   389→		}
   390→
   391→		lineNumber++
   392→		if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
   393→			return fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB)", lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/mb)
   394→		}
   395→
   396→		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\n")
   397→		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r")
   398→		if line == "" {
   399→			if err == io.EOF {
   400→				break
   401→			}
   402→			continue
   403→		}
   404→
   405→		if handleErr := handle(line); handleErr != nil {
   406→			return handleErr
   407→		}
   408→
   409→		if err == io.EOF {
   410→			break
   411→		}
   412→	}
   413→
   414→	return nil
   415→}
```
